accenture.name: Accenture
accenture.description: Accenture plc is a technology consulting company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland. Founded in 1989 in the United States, it provides information technology and management consulting services across 120 countries globally.

aviation-industry-corporation-of-china-l.name: Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Ltd.
aviation-industry-corporation-of-china-l.legal_name: Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Ltd.
aviation-industry-corporation-of-china-l.description: The Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) is a Chinese state-owned aerospace and defense conglomerate headquartered in Beijing. It has over 100 subsidiaries, 27 listed companies, and 500,000 employees globally. AVIC is the sixth largest defense contractor worldwide as of 2022.

listings.name: Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Ltd.

agricultural-bank-of-china.name: Agricultural Bank of China
agricultural-bank-of-china.description: The Agricultural Bank of China (ABC) is a largely state-owned multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Beijing, China. Founded in 1951, it is one of the "big four" banks in China and the second largest bank in the world by total assets. ABC has branches in major cities worldwide including Hong Kong, London, and New York.

at-t.name: AT&T
at-t.description: AT&T Inc. is an American multinational telecommunications holding company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It is the third-largest telecommunications company by revenue globally and the largest fiber internet provider in the United States.

albertsons.name: Albertsons
albertsons.description: Albertsons Companies, Inc. is an American grocery company founded and headquartered in Boise, Idaho. It operates in the retail industry, focusing on grocery products.

america-movil-mexico.name: América Móvil
america-movil-mexico.description: América Móvil, S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican telecommunications corporation headquartered in Mexico City. It is the seventh largest mobile network operator worldwide by equity subscribers and a Forbes Global 2000 company.

anheuser-busch-inbev.name: Anheuser-Busch InBev
anheuser-busch-inbev.description: Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV, known as AB InBev, is an American-Belgian multinational drink and brewing company based in Leuven, Belgium. It is the largest brewer in the world and was ranked 72nd in the Forbes Global 2000 in 2023.

arcelormittal.name: ArcelorMittal
arcelormittal.description: ArcelorMittal S.A. is a multinational steel manufacturing corporation headquartered in Luxembourg City. It operates in iron ore and coke mining as well as scrap recycling and was the largest steelmaker worldwide until 2019.

abb-group.name: ABB Group
abb-group.description: ABB Group is a Swedish-Swiss technology company operating in electrification and automation. It was formed in 1988 from the merger of ASEA of Sweden and Brown, Boveri & Cie of Switzerland. The company focuses on technology solutions in its sectors.

atos-se.name: Atos SE
atos-se.description: Atos SE is a European multinational IT service and consulting company headquartered in Bezons, France. It specializes in hi-tech transactional services, unified communications, cloud, big data, and cybersecurity. The company operates worldwide under the brands Atos, Syntel, and Eviden.

associated-british-foods.name: Associated British Foods
associated-british-foods.description: Associated British Foods plc is a British multinational company headquartered in London. It operates in the food processing and retailing industry. The company is known for its diverse food-related businesses.

ab-volvo.name: AB Volvo
ab-volvo.description: Volvo Group is a Swedish multinational manufacturing corporation based in Gothenburg. It produces and sells trucks, buses, and construction equipment, and also supplies marine and industrial drive systems and financial services. In 2016, it was the world's second-largest manufacturer of heavy-duty trucks.

aisin-seiki.name: Aisin Seiki
aisin-seiki.description: Aisin Corporation is a Japanese company that develops and produces automotive components and systems. It is a member of the Toyota Group and was ranked 359 on the Fortune Global 500 in 2020. The company serves the automotive industry worldwide.

air-france-klm.name: Air France-KLM
air-france-klm.description: Air France–KLM S.A. is a French–Dutch multinational airline holding company headquartered in Paris, France. It was formed by the 2004 merger of Air France and KLM and operates major hubs at Paris–Charles de Gaulle, Paris Orly, and Amsterdam Schiphol airports.

audi-ag.name: Audi AG
audi-ag.description: Audi AG is a German automotive manufacturer of luxury vehicles headquartered in Ingolstadt, Bavaria. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Volkswagen Group and operates nine production facilities worldwide.

aeon.name: Aeon
aeon.description: Aeon Co., Ltd., formerly Jusco Co., Ltd., is a Japanese diversified retail holding company. It owns Aeon hypermarkets, shopping malls, supermarkets, convenience stores, drugstores, movie theaters, and a bank, making it one of the largest retail companies in Japan.

aon-plc.name: Aon plc
aon-plc.description: Aon plc is an international professional services firm based in the United Kingdom. It has two divisions: Risk Capital, offering brokerage and consulting for risk management and insurance, and Human Capital, providing services related to health insurance, retirement, and talent advisory.

american-express.name: American Express
american-express.description: American Express Company is an American multinational financial services corporation specializing in payment cards. It is headquartered at 200 Vesey Street in Lower Manhattan and announced plans in 2026 to develop and occupy the new 2 World Trade Center skyscraper.

alcoa.name: Alcoa
alcoa.description: Alcoa Corporation is an American industrial corporation producing aluminum. It operates in 10 countries and is involved in mining, refining, smelting, fabricating, and recycling aluminum products. It is among the largest aluminum producers globally.

acciona.name: Acciona
acciona.description: Acciona, S.A. is a Spanish multinational conglomerate focused on infrastructure development and renewable energy management. Through its subsidiary Acciona Energía, it produces 21 terawatt-hours of renewable electricity annually. The company is based in Spain.

air-china.name: Air China
air-china.description: Air China Limited is the flag carrier airline of the People's Republic of China, headquartered in Shunyi, Beijing. It offers domestic and international flights to various destinations within China and worldwide.

all-nippon-airways.name: All Nippon Airways
all-nippon-airways.description: All Nippon Airways (ANA) is a Japanese airline headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It operates over 100 domestic and international destinations with main hubs at Haneda and Narita airports. ANA is Japan's largest airline and has been a Star Alliance member since 1999.

auo-corporation.name: AUO Corporation
auo-corporation.description: AUO Corporation is a Taiwanese company specializing in optoelectronics, formed in 2001 by merging Acer Display Technology and Unipac Optoelectronics. It offers display panels and has expanded into smart retail, transportation, health, solar energy, circular economy, and smart manufacturing.

avon-products-inc.name: Avon Products Inc.
avon-products-inc.description: Avon Products, Inc., known as Avon, is an Anglo-American multinational company selling cosmetics, skin care, perfume, and personal care products. It operates as a multi-level marketing company based in London.

avery-dennison.name: Avery Dennison
avery-dennison.description: Avery Dennison Corporation is an American multinational manufacturer and distributor of pressure-sensitive adhesive materials, apparel branding labels, RFID inlays, and specialty medical products. It is headquartered in Mentor, Ohio and is a Fortune 500 company.

akindo-sushiro.name: Akindo Sushiro
akindo-sushiro.description: Akindo Sushiro is a Japanese multinational conveyor belt sushi specialty store headquartered in Suita, Osaka. It operates in the restaurant industry.

asahi-kasei.name: Asahi Kasei
asahi-kasei.description: Asahi Kasei Corporation is a multinational Japanese chemical company. Its main products include chemicals and materials.

alrosa.name: ALROSA
alrosa.description: Alrosa is a Russian group of diamond mining companies specializing in exploration, mining, manufacture, and sale of diamonds. It leads the world in diamond mining by volume and accounts for 95% of Russian diamond production.

amc-theatres.name: AMC Theatres
amc-theatres.description: AMC Entertainment Holdings, Inc., known as AMC Theatres, is an American movie theater chain headquartered in Leawood, Kansas. It is the largest movie exhibition company globally, with approximately 860 theaters and 9,600 screens worldwide. Founded in 1920, AMC expanded significantly through acquisitions including Odeon Cinemas and Carmike Cinemas.

archer-daniels-midland.name: Archer Daniels Midland
archer-daniels-midland.description: The Archer-Daniels-Midland Company (ADM) is an American multinational food processing and commodities trading corporation founded in 1902. It is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. ADM operates in the food processing industry.

arcelik.name: Arçelik
arcelik.description: Arçelik A.Ş. is a Turkish multinational manufacturer of household appliances. It operates in the consumer electronics industry and is based in Turkey.

astra-agro-lestari.name: Astra Agro Lestari
astra-agro-lestari.description: Astra Agro Lestari Tbk. is the second largest palm oil company in Indonesia and a subsidiary of PT Astra International Tbk. It controlled extensive land banks as of 2004, including two concessions on peatlands in Riau totaling about 20,000 hectares.

aviva.name: Aviva
aviva.description: Aviva plc is a British multinational insurance company headquartered in London, England. It serves about 25.3 million customers across the UK, Ireland, and Canada. Aviva is the UK's only diversified insurer and the second-largest general insurer in Canada.

aeropostale.name: Aéropostale
aeropostale.description: Aéropostale Inc. is an American retailer specializing in casual apparel and accessories for young adults and teenagers. Founded by Macy's, it is currently owned by Catalyst Brands and sells products through its own stores, website, and third-party retailers like Target in the U.S.

asseco-poland.name: Asseco Poland
asseco-poland.description: Asseco Poland S.A. is a Polish multinational software company founded in 1991 and headquartered in Rzeszów, Poland. It develops enterprise software primarily for banking and finance industries and operates in over 60 countries. It is one of the largest technology companies listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and the largest software house in Central and Eastern Europe.

agco.name: AGCO
agco.description: AGCO Corporation is an American agricultural machinery manufacturer headquartered in Duluth, Georgia. Founded in 1990, it designs, produces, and sells tractors, combines, sprayers, and smart farming technologies. The company focuses on equipment for agriculture and farming.

amadeus-it-group.name: Amadeus IT Group
amadeus-it-group.description: Amadeus IT Group, S.A. is a Spanish multinational technology company providing software for the global travel and tourism industry. The parent company holds over 99.7% of Amadeus IT Group, which has been listed on Spanish stock exchanges since April 2010.

americanas.name: Americanas
americanas.description: Americanas, formerly Lojas Americanas, is a Brazilian retail chain founded in 1929 in Niterói, Rio de Janeiro. It operates 1,945 stores across all 26 Brazilian states and the Federal District, making it the sixth largest retailer in Brazil.

alfa-laval.name: Alfa Laval
alfa-laval.description: Alfa Laval AB is a Swedish company founded in 1883 that initially provided centrifuges for dairies. It now produces specialized products for heavy industry used to heat, cool, separate, and transport various substances including oil, water, chemicals, and foodstuffs.

amgen.name: Amgen
amgen.description: Amgen Inc. is an American multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Thousand Oaks, California. It ranks 18th among the largest biomedical companies by revenue. The name AMGen is derived from Applied Molecular Genetics.

agilent-technologies.name: Agilent Technologies
agilent-technologies.description: Agilent Technologies, Inc. is an American global company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It provides instruments, software, services, and consumables for laboratories. Agilent was established in 1999 as a spin-off from Hewlett-Packard.

asus.name: ASUS
asus.description: Asus, officially Asustek Computer Inc., is a Taiwanese multinational company headquartered in Taipei. It manufactures a wide range of computer, phone hardware, and electronics products including desktops, laptops, mobile phones, and networking equipment. Asus also operates as an original equipment manufacturer (OEM).

aker-solutions.name: Aker Solutions
aker-solutions.description: Aker Solutions ASA is a Norwegian engineering firm headquartered near Oslo. It focuses on energy infrastructure, including systems and services for de-carbonizing oil and gas production, wind-to-grid infrastructure, and CO2 capture and sequestration. The company operates in the energy engineering sector.

acron-group.name: Acron Group
acron-group.description: Acron Group is a global Russian producer of mineral fertilizers. The company operates internationally in the chemical industry, focusing on fertilizer production.

atlassian.name: Atlassian
atlassian.description: Atlassian is a multinational proprietary software company headquartered in Sydney, Australia. It specializes in collaboration tools primarily designed for software development and project management. The company serves a global market with its software products.

axia-energia.name: Axia Energia
axia-energia.description: Axia Energia S.A. is a major electric utilities company based in Brazil. Its headquarters are located in Rio de Janeiro. The company operates in the renewables and utilities sector.

ashok-leyland.name: Ashok Leyland
ashok-leyland.description: Ashok Leyland Limited is an Indian multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Chennai. Founded in 1948 as Ashok Motors, it was renamed Ashok Leyland in 1955 after collaborating with British Leyland. It is one of the largest commercial vehicle manufacturers in India.

arrium.name: Arrium
arrium.description: Arrium was an Australian mining and materials company that employed nearly 10,000 workers before entering voluntary administration in 2016. It was acquired in 2017 by the British-owned Liberty House Group. The company was based in Australia and operated in the mining sector.

asiana-airlines.name: Asiana Airlines
asiana-airlines.description: Asiana Airlines Inc. is a South Korean airline headquartered in Seoul. It operates numerous international, domestic, and cargo routes across Asia, Europe, and North America, with hubs at Incheon and Gimpo International Airports. The airline is set to merge with Korean Air in December 2026.

altria.name: Altria
altria.description: Altria Group, Inc. is an American corporation and one of the world's largest producers and marketers of tobacco and cigarettes. It operates worldwide and is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia.

allegheny-technologies.name: Allegheny Technologies
allegheny-technologies.description: ATI Inc. is an American producer of specialty materials headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It produces metals including titanium, nickel-based alloys, stainless steels, zirconium, hafnium, niobium, tungsten materials, forgings, and castings.

aperam.name: Aperam
aperam.description: Aperam S.A. is a global leader in stainless, electrical, alloy, and specialty steels with recycling activities. It operates facilities in Brazil, Belgium, and France, focusing on stainless and specialty steel production. The company is listed on multiple European stock exchanges including Amsterdam and Luxembourg.

asics.name: ASICS
asics.description: ASICS Corporation is a Japanese multinational sportswear company headquartered in Kobe, Hyōgo Prefecture. It manufactures athletic and lifestyle footwear, apparel, and sports equipment, with a focus on running shoes and the Onitsuka Tiger brand.

akamai-technologies.name: Akamai Technologies
akamai-technologies.description: Akamai Technologies, Inc. is an American company specializing in content delivery networks, cybersecurity, DDoS mitigation, and cloud services. The company is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

abercrombie-fitch.name: Abercrombie & Fitch
abercrombie-fitch.description: Abercrombie & Fitch Co. is an American lifestyle retailer headquartered in New Albany, Ohio. Founded in 1892, it targets customers in their early 20s to mid 40s and operates several offshoot brands including Hollister Co. and Abercrombie Kids.

af-gruppen.name: AF Gruppen
af-gruppen.description: AF Group ASA is the third largest civil engineering and construction company in Norway, headquartered in Oslo. The company is publicly listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

antofagasta-plc.name: Antofagasta plc
antofagasta-plc.description: Antofagasta plc is a London-based Chilean multinational conglomerate with equity in mining and railroad operations. It participates in Antofagasta Minerals, a railroad to Bolivia, and other ventures worldwide. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 100 Index.

airbnb.name: Airbnb
airbnb.description: Airbnb, Inc. is an American company operating an online marketplace for short- and long-term homestays, experiences, and services globally. It acts as a broker charging commissions on bookings. The company was founded in 2008 by Brian Chesky, Nathan Blecharczyk, and Joe Gebbia.

amp-limited.name: AMP Limited
amp-limited.description: AMP Limited is an Australian financial services company headquartered in Sydney. It operates in Australia and New Zealand, offering superannuation, investment products, and banking services including home loans and savings accounts through AMP Banking.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.description: Anthropic, PBC is an American artificial intelligence public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. Founded in January 2021 by former OpenAI members, it develops proprietary large language models, including its flagship product Claude. Anthropic had the largest initial public offering in November 2026.

atlantic-grupa.name: Atlantic Grupa
atlantic-grupa.description: Atlantic Grupa d.d. is a Croatian multinational company engaged in the production, development, sales, and distribution of consumer goods. It has a market presence in over 40 countries worldwide.

atmel.name: Atmel
atmel.description: Atmel Corporation was a semiconductor creator and manufacturer founded in 1984 and later acquired by Microchip Technology in 2016. It focused on embedded systems with products including microcontrollers, RF devices, EEPROM, flash memory, security chips, and touch sensors.

ambu.name: Ambu
ambu.description: Ambu A/S is a Danish company that develops, produces, and markets single-use endoscopy solutions, diagnostic, and life-supporting equipment. Its products serve hospitals, private practices, and rescue services.

azelis-group.name: Azelis Group
azelis-group.description: Azelis Group is a Belgium-based distributor specializing in food ingredients and specialty chemicals. Headquartered in Antwerp, it has a presence in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Asia-Pacific, and the Americas. The company has been listed on Euronext since 2021.

anritsu.name: Anritsu
anritsu.description: Anritsu Corporation is a Japanese multinational corporation in the telecommunications electronics equipment market. It is known as a global pioneer for producing the world's first wireless telephone network.

alexion-pharmaceuticals.name: Alexion Pharmaceuticals
alexion-pharmaceuticals.description: Alexion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company based in New Haven, Connecticut, United States. It specializes in orphan drugs for rare diseases and is a subsidiary of AstraZeneca.

asian-development-bank.name: Asian Development Bank
asian-development-bank.description: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) is a regional development bank headquartered in Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, Philippines. It promotes social and economic development in Asia and maintains 31 field offices worldwide.

asiacell.name: AsiaCell
asiacell.description: Asiacell Telecom Company is an Iraqi telecommunications company providing mobile phone services and mobile internet primarily in Iraq.

alk-abello.name: ALK-Abelló
alk-abello.description: ALK-Abelló A/S is a Denmark-based pharmaceutical company specializing in allergy immunotherapy products for prevention and treatment. It is one of the world's largest makers of allergy immunotherapy products, with 67% of its revenue from European sales.

austal.name: Austal
austal.description: Austal Limited is an Australian global shipbuilding company and defence prime contractor. It specializes in designing, constructing, and supporting defence and commercial vessels, including naval vessels, high-speed ferries, and offshore windfarm supply vessels.

alm-brand.name: Alm. Brand
alm-brand.description: Alm. Brand is a Danish financial services group operating in the markets for non-life, life, and pension insurance. It is based in Denmark and provides a range of insurance products. The company focuses on financial services within the insurance sector.

amc-global-media.name: AMC Global Media
amc-global-media.description: AMC Global Media Inc. is an American independent mass media and entertainment corporation based in New York City. It owns and operates multiple cable channels, streaming services, and independent film companies. The company also holds a minority interest in Canadian production studio Shaftesbury Films.

adtran.name: Adtran
adtran.description: Adtran, Inc. is an American fiber networking and telecommunications company headquartered in Huntsville, Alabama. It provides networking equipment and administrative software to communications service providers, governments, enterprises, and utilities.

argenx-se.name: Argenx SE
argenx-se.description: Argenx SE is a Belgian-Dutch pharmaceutical company specializing in immunology. It focuses on developing antibody therapies for autoimmune diseases and cancer, with an emphasis on orphan drugs. The company operates in the biotechnology sector.

ad-plastik.name: AD Plastik
ad-plastik.description: AD Plastik is a Croatian manufacturer of automotive components based in Solin. It develops and produces parts for car interiors and exteriors and is a leading company in Eastern Europe. The group includes operations in Romania, Hungary, Serbia, and Russia, exporting mainly to Western Europe.

almirall.name: Almirall
almirall.description: Almirall, S.A. is a Spanish pharmaceutical company focused on medical dermatology. It was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Barcelona. The company specializes in developing treatments related to skin conditions.

aspentech-corp.name: AspenTech Corp.
aspentech-corp.description: Aspen Technology, Inc., known as AspenTech, provides software and services for the process industries. It is headquartered in Bedford, Massachusetts, and has 35 offices globally.

antibiotice-iasi.name: Antibiotice Iași
antibiotice-iasi.description: Antibiotice Iași is a public pharmaceutical company in Romania, known as one of the largest drug producers in the country. It is majority-owned by the Romanian Ministry of Health and has its research center and production facilities in Valea Lupului near Iași.

aes-andes.name: AES Andes
aes-andes.description: AES Andes S.A. is an electricity producer and distributor based in Santiago, Chile. It is a subsidiary of the American AES Corporation and operates in the Andes region of South America.

azenta-life-sciences.name: Azenta Life Sciences
azenta-life-sciences.description: Azenta Life Sciences is a life sciences services provider based in Burlington, Massachusetts, United States. Founded in 1978, it offers genomics, cryogenic storage, automation, and informatics services.

aloqabank.name: Aloqabank
aloqabank.description: Joint-Stock Commercial Aloqabank is a banking and financial services company headquartered in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. It operates in the banking sector within Uzbekistan.

ateam-holdings.name: Ateam Holdings
ateam-holdings.description: Ateam Inc. is a provider of mobile content and websites based in Nagoya, Japan. It operates in the mobile content industry.

aixtron-se.name: Aixtron SE
aixtron-se.description: Aixtron SE is a German technology company headquartered in Herzogenrath. It develops chemical vapor deposition equipment for electronic and optoelectronic applications, including metalorganic and plasma-enhanced systems. Aixtron is a leading manufacturer in its field and is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange.

atlantic-tele-network.name: Atlantic Tele-Network
atlantic-tele-network.description: ATN International, Inc., formerly Atlantic Tele-Network, is an American telecommunications company headquartered in Beverly, Massachusetts. It operates digital wireless, wireline, and fiber optic networks serving geographically and technically challenging markets in the United States.

a-g-barr.name: A.G. Barr
a-g-barr.description: A.G. Barr p.l.c., known as Barr's, is a soft drink and energy drink manufacturer based in Cumbernauld, Scotland. It is widely known for producing the drink Irn-Bru and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

alinco.name: Alinco
alinco.description: Alinco is a Japanese manufacturer producing radio and amplification equipment. In Japan, it also offers metal products, construction equipment, and exercise equipment.

audiocodes-ltd.name: Audiocodes Ltd.
audiocodes-ltd.description: AudioCodes Ltd. is an Israeli technology company providing communication software, hardware, and productivity solutions for enterprises and service providers.

altri.name: Altri
altri.description: Altri SGPS SA is a Portuguese industrial conglomerate headquartered in Porto. Its main operations include wood pulp production, forest cultivation for timber and paper, and co-generation of energy including renewable resources. The group previously operated in the steelworks industry before 2008.

american-shipping-company.name: American Shipping Company
american-shipping-company.description: American Shipping Company ASA is a Norwegian-American shipping and shipyard company and part of the Aker Group. Formerly known as Aker American Shipping ASA, Aker ASA reduced its ownership from 53.2% to 19.9% in 2008.

aercap.name: AerCap
aercap.description: AerCap Holdings N.V. is an Irish aviation leasing company based in Dublin, with its registered office in Amsterdam. It became the largest aviation leasing company globally after acquiring ILFC in 2014 and GECAS in 2021. The company operates in the financial services sector.

autostore.name: AutoStore
autostore.description: AutoStore AS is a Norwegian manufacturer of automated storage and retrieval systems that combine automation, software, and AI for intelligent fulfillment. The company is headquartered in Nedre Vats, Norway, and operates globally with offices in Europe, the United States, Asia, and Australia.

abg-sundal-collier.name: ABG Sundal Collier
abg-sundal-collier.description: ABG Sundal Collier Holding ASA is a Nordic investment bank headquartered in Oslo, Norway. Founded in 1984, it offers investment banking, stock broking, and corporate advisory services to institutional investors and high net-worth individuals. The company has offices across Europe and the US.

asrock.name: ASRock
asrock.description: ASRock Inc. is a Taiwanese manufacturer specializing in motherboards, industrial PCs, and home theater PCs. The company operates in the computer industry and is based in Taiwan.

aurskog-sparebank.name: Aurskog Sparebank
aurskog-sparebank.description: Aurskog Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Aurskog, Norway. Its main market is the Romerike district of Akershus. The bank's equity certificates were listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange in 1998.

aker.name: Aker
aker.description: Aker ASA is a Norwegian industrial investment company with ownership interests in oil and gas, renewable energy, green technologies, industrial software, seafood, and marine biotechnology. It is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and headquartered in Fornebu, Norway. The company was established in 1841.

arendals-fossekompani.name: Arendals Fossekompani
arendals-fossekompani.description: Arendals Fossekompani ASA is a Norwegian company based in Arendal. Its main business is producing and selling electric energy from two hydroelectric power plants. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

axactor.name: Axactor
axactor.description: Axactor ASA is a multinational debt buyer headquartered in Oslo, Norway. Founded in 2015, it has expanded through acquisitions in several European countries and is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

aurora-innovation.name: Aurora Innovation
aurora-innovation.description: Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a self-driving vehicle technology company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA. It developed the Aurora Driver, a system for autonomous driving, and was co-founded by former leaders from Google, Tesla, and Uber's autonomy teams.

anhui-heli.name: Anhui Heli
anhui-heli.description: Heli is a Chinese construction equipment maker primarily known for producing forklift trucks. It is the largest forklift maker in China and the seventh largest worldwide based on 2018 sales revenue. The company operates in the construction and cement industry.

aaron-s-inc.name: Aaron's, Inc.
aaron-s-inc.description: Aaron's, Inc. is an American lease-to-own retailer specializing in furniture, electronics, appliances, and computers. It operates through company-owned and franchised stores as well as an e-commerce platform. The company is known for its lease and retail sales model.

asmallworld.name: ASmallWorld
asmallworld.description: ASMALLWORLD operates a digital travel and luxury lifestyle ecosystem based in Zürich, Switzerland. It enables members to find inspiration, book unique journeys, and connect with like-minded individuals including notable personalities.

alma-media.name: Alma Media
alma-media.description: Alma Media Oyj is a Finnish media and digital service company known for products such as Iltalehti, Kauppalehti, Talouselämä, Ampparit, Monster.fi, and Etuovi.com. It operates primarily in publishing and digital services.

ariston.name: Ariston
ariston.description: Ariston Holding N.V., known as Ariston, is an Italian multinational company operating in the thermal comfort sector. It produces solutions for space and water heating, including burners and components.

asahi-broadcasting-group-holdings.name: Asahi Broadcasting Group Holdings
asahi-broadcasting-group-holdings.description: Asahi Broadcasting Group Holdings Corporation is a certified broadcasting holding company headquartered in Osaka, Japan. In 2018, it spun off its radio and television broadcasting divisions into separate subsidiaries for radio and television.

anora-group.name: Anora Group
anora-group.description: Anora Group Plc is a Nordic distilled beverage and wine company headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. It was formed in 2021 through the merger of Norway's Arcus Group and Finland's Altia Group, with offices in Nordic capital cities.

archer-aviation.name: Archer Aviation
archer-aviation.description: Archer Aviation Inc. is an aerospace and defense technology company headquartered in San Jose, California. It develops eVTOL aircraft intended for urban air taxi and defense operations. The company operates in the aviation sector.

adani-wilmar.name: Adani Wilmar
adani-wilmar.description: AWL Agri Business, formerly Adani Wilmar, is an Indian multinational food and beverage conglomerate based in Ahmedabad. Founded in 1999 as a joint venture, it is India's largest processor of edible oils with operations across India and exports globally.

asana-inc.name: Asana Inc.
asana-inc.description: Asana, Inc. is an American software company based in San Francisco, California. It offers a web and mobile work management platform designed to help teams organize and manage their work, founded in 2008.

abc-mart.name: ABC-Mart
abc-mart.description: ABC-Mart, Inc. is a Japanese footwear company with stores in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and the Philippines.

ast-spacemobile.name: AST SpaceMobile
ast-spacemobile.description: AST SpaceMobile, Inc. is a publicly traded satellite designer and manufacturer based in Midland, Texas, United States. The company is developing the SpaceMobile satellite constellation, a space-based cellular broadband network designed to connect directly to standard smartphones. The network aims to provide 4G and 5G coverage globally, especially in remote and underserved areas.

a-d-company.name: A&D Company
a-d-company.description: A&D Company, Limited is a Japanese company. Further details about its operations or industry are not provided in the summary.

atria-group.name: Atria Group
atria-group.description: Atria Plc is a Finnish food industry company with roots dating back to 1903. It originated from a livestock sales co-operative and is listed on the Helsinki stock exchange.

austevoll-seafood.name: Austevoll Seafood
austevoll-seafood.description: Austevoll Seafood ASA is a major seafood company based in Norway.

apa-corporation.name: APA Corporation
apa-corporation.description: APA Corporation is an American holding company for Apache Corporation engaged in hydrocarbon exploration. It is organized in Delaware and headquartered in Houston, Texas.

abdullah-alothaim-markets.name: Abdullah AlOthaim Markets
abdullah-alothaim-markets.description: Abdullah Al-Othaim Markets Company is a Saudi Arabian retail company that originated as an extension of Saleh Al Othaim Trading Establishment founded in 1956. Established in 1980, it expanded wholesale and retail foodstuff sales across Saudi Arabia.

alumindo-light-metal-industry.name: Alumindo Light Metal Industry
alumindo-light-metal-industry.description: PT Alumindo Light Metal Industry Tbk is the largest flat rolled aluminium manufacturer in South East Asia. It is headquartered in Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia. The company produces aluminum sheets used in household appliances, transportation equipment, and building materials, as well as tin sheets for packaging.

albemarle-corporation.name: Albemarle Corporation
albemarle-corporation.description: Albemarle Corporation is an American specialty chemicals and mining company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It produces lithium compounds for electric-vehicle batteries and bromine-based specialty chemicals including flame retardants.

allegiant-air.name: Allegiant Air
allegiant-air.description: Allegiant Air is an American ultra-low-cost airline headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. It focuses on leisure travel from small and medium-sized cities, offering low base fares with additional fees for extra services.

aircastle.name: Aircastle
aircastle.description: Aircastle Limited is an aircraft leasing company headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, with offices in Dublin and Singapore. It acquires, leases, and sells commercial jet aircraft to airlines globally. The company was incorporated in 2004.

archion.name: Archion
archion.description: Archion is a Japanese holding company headquartered in Shinagawa, Tokyo. It was founded to assume full ownership of truck manufacturing companies Mitsubishi Fuso, Hino, and Rizon Trucks in 2026 following their merger agreement.

atotech.name: Atotech
atotech.description: Atotech is a German speciality chemicals and equipment company operating in 40 countries. It provides chemistry and equipment for manufacturing printed circuit boards, IC-substrates, semiconductors, and surface finishing in various industries including automotive and construction.

alleghany-corporation.name: Alleghany Corporation
alleghany-corporation.description: Alleghany Corporation is an American investment holding company originally created by railroad entrepreneurs Oris and Mantis Van Sweringen. Incorporated in 1929 and reincorporated in Delaware in 1984, it was acquired by Berkshire Hathaway in October 2022 following an offer in March 2022.

air-berlin.name: Air Berlin
air-berlin.description: Air Berlin was a major German airline headquartered in Berlin. It was Germany's second-largest airline and Europe's tenth-largest by passengers carried. The airline had hubs at Berlin Tegel and Düsseldorf Airports and was a member of the Oneworld alliance.

arcos-dorados-holdings.name: Arcos Dorados Holdings
arcos-dorados-holdings.description: Arcos Dorados Holdings is the master franchise of McDonald's in 20 countries and territories across Latin America and the Caribbean. It operates nearly 2,400 restaurants, making it the largest independent McDonald's franchisee globally and the largest quick-service restaurant chain in the region.

airborne-maintenance-engineering-service.name: Airborne Maintenance & Engineering Services
airborne-maintenance-engineering-service.description: Airborne Maintenance & Engineering Services is a US-based MRO company located in Wilmington, Ohio, providing aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul services. It holds FAA certification and operates multiple facilities including line maintenance stations and offers Boeing 737 cargo conversion services through its subsidiary.

adventa.name: Adventa
adventa.description: Adventa Berhad is a Malaysian holding company headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. Founded in 2004, it initially invested in the glove-making business but later divested it and acquired companies leading to healthcare businesses. Its operations include distribution and third-party logistics for other healthcare companies.

a10-networks.name: A10 Networks
a10-networks.description: A10 Networks, Inc. is an American public company that manufactures application delivery controllers. Founded in 2004 by Lee Chen, it initially focused on identity management products and later expanded to bandwidth management appliances. The company went public in 2014.

auburn-national-bancorporation.name: Auburn National Bancorporation
auburn-national-bancorporation.description: Auburn Bank is an American community bank operating in eastern Alabama. It offers financial products such as checking, savings, and lending services. The bank is a member of the Federal Home Loan Bank of Atlanta and is regulated by the Alabama Superintendent of Banks.

allegion.name: Allegion
allegion.description: Allegion plc is an American company domiciled in Ireland that provides security products for homes and businesses.

acceleron-pharma.name: Acceleron Pharma
acceleron-pharma.description: Acceleron Pharma, Inc. is an American clinical stage biopharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It focuses on developing medicines that regulate the transforming growth factor beta superfamily of proteins involved in cell and tissue growth and repair.

advanced-accelerator-applications.name: Advanced Accelerator Applications
advanced-accelerator-applications.description: Advanced Accelerator Applications is a pharmaceutical group based in France specializing in nuclear medicine. It operates in all three segments of nuclear medicine to diagnose and treat serious conditions in oncology, neurology, cardiology, infectious and inflammatory diseases.

agios-pharmaceuticals.name: Agios Pharmaceuticals
agios-pharmaceuticals.description: Agios Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a publicly traded American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Founded in 2008, it pioneers therapies for genetically defined diseases with a focus on hemolytic anemias.

andatee-china-marine-fuel.name: Andatee China Marine Fuel
andatee-china-marine-fuel.description: Andatee China Marine Fuel Service Corporation is a marine fuel wholesale and retail company based in Dalian, China. It sells oil fuel products mainly to one municipality and four provinces in Northeast and East China and has subsidiaries including a joint venture with CPC Corp.

alliance-bank.name: Alliance Bank
alliance-bank.description: Alliance Bank Malaysia Berhad, known as Alliance Bank, is a publicly traded banking and financial institution in Malaysia.

annaly-capital-management.name: Annaly Capital Management
annaly-capital-management.description: Annaly Capital Management, Inc. is one of the largest mortgage real estate investment trusts. It is organized in Maryland with its principal office in New York City.

aac-technologies-holdings-inc.name: AAC Technologies Holdings Inc
aac-technologies-holdings-inc.description: AAC Technologies Holdings, Inc. is a civilian-run enterprise engaged in the design, development, manufacture, and distribution of miniaturized components. It is based in China.

alnylam-pharmaceuticals.name: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals
alnylam-pharmaceuticals.description: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Founded in 2002, it focuses on RNA interference therapeutics for genetically defined diseases. The company was recognized by Forbes in 2016 as one of the 100 Most Innovative Growth Companies.

amag-pharmaceuticals.name: AMAG Pharmaceuticals
amag-pharmaceuticals.description: AMAG Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical company that develops treatments for iron deficiency anemia in adults. It was publicly traded on NASDAQ until its acquisition by Covis Pharma in November 2020.

american-states-water.name: American States Water
american-states-water.description: American States Water Co. is a utility company headquartered in San Dimas, California, providing water and electricity services. Founded in 1929, it holds 50-year privatization contracts with the U.S. government and serves customers in California under the Bear Valley Electric name.

amwell.name: Amwell
amwell.description: Amwell, officially American Well Corporation, is a telemedicine company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It connects patients with doctors via secure video and offers a subscription platform and software tools to healthcare providers for integrating telehealth into their workflows.

assertio-therapeutics.name: Assertio Therapeutics
assertio-therapeutics.description: Assertio Therapeutics, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company headquartered in Newark, California. It markets products for neurology and pain treatment and was formerly known as Depomed until its name change in 2018.

avadel-pharmaceuticals.name: Avadel Pharmaceuticals
avadel-pharmaceuticals.description: Avadel Pharmaceuticals plc was an Irish specialty pharmaceutical company focused on sleep disorder medicines. Headquartered in Dublin, it had operations in the US and France and developed the FDA-approved anti-narcolepsy drug LUMRYZ before being acquired in 2026.

amneal-pharmaceuticals-inc.name: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
amneal-pharmaceuticals-inc.description: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey. It develops, manufactures, and distributes generic and specialty pharmaceutical products and is one of the largest generic drug manufacturers in the U.S.

airtasker.name: Airtasker
airtasker.description: Airtasker is a Sydney-based Australian company providing an online and mobile marketplace. It enables users to outsource everyday tasks by describing the task and indicating a budget, allowing community members to bid for completion. The company operates in the software and AI sector.

aimia.name: Aimia
aimia.description: Aimia Inc. is a global investment holding company based in Montreal, Canada. It is publicly listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange. Originally a loyalty solutions provider from Air Canada's Aeroplan program, it restructured in 2020 to become an investment holding company.

arbutus-biopharma.name: Arbutus Biopharma
arbutus-biopharma.description: Arbutus Biopharma Corporation is a Canadian biopharmaceutical company specializing in liposomal drug delivery and RNA interference. It is developing drugs for hepatitis B infection and is publicly traded.

amicus-therapeutics.name: Amicus Therapeutics
amicus-therapeutics.description: Amicus Therapeutics, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company based in Princeton, New Jersey. Founded before 2007, it went public in 2007 and is now a subsidiary of BioMarin Pharmaceutical.

ally-financial.name: Ally Financial
ally-financial.description: Ally Financial Inc. is an American bank holding company headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. It provides financial services including car finance, online banking, corporate lending, vehicle insurance, mortgage loans, and related financing services.

allison-transmission.name: Allison Transmission
allison-transmission.description: Allison Transmission Holdings, Inc. is an American manufacturer specializing in commercial duty automatic transmissions and hybrid propulsion systems. Its products are used by over 250 vehicle manufacturers across various sectors including bus, refuse, fire, construction, distribution, military, and specialty applications.

alon-blue-square-israel-ltd.name: Alon Blue Square Israel Ltd
alon-blue-square-israel-ltd.description: Alon Blue Square is a private Israeli holding company based in Yakum. Originally founded as a retail chain, it later expanded into real estate and other fields. The company is owned by Moti Ben-Moshe.

akorn.name: Akorn
akorn.description: Akorn Operating Company LLC was an American generic pharmaceuticals manufacturer based in Lake Forest, Illinois. It developed, manufactured, and marketed generic and prescription drugs as well as animal and consumer health products. It was part of the NASDAQ Biotechnology Index.

amarin-corporations.name: Amarin Corporations
amarin-corporations.description: Amarin Corporations Public Company Limited is a Thai media company known as Amarin Group. It publishes magazines, operates the Naiin bookstore chain, and runs Amarin TV. The company has been listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand since 1993.

areeya-property-pcl.name: Areeya Property (PCL.)
areeya-property-pcl.description: Areeya Property (PCL.) is a company founded in 2000 that develops real estate projects under the name 'Areeya'. It operates in the real estate sector.

arrow-electronics.name: Arrow Electronics
arrow-electronics.description: Arrow Electronics, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Centennial, Colorado. It provides electronic components and enterprise computing products, specializing in distribution and value-added services for various commercial customers.

arch-resources.name: Arch Resources
arch-resources.description: Arch Resources, formerly Arch Coal, was an American coal mining and processing company. It mined and marketed bituminous and sub-bituminous coal with low sulfur content, supplying about 15% of the US domestic market mainly to electricity generators.

alupar.name: Alupar
alupar.description: Alupar is a Brazilian holding company dedicated to power generation and transmission. It is one of the largest companies in its segment by Annual Permitted Revenue and is the largest privately held company in this sector in Brazil.

alico.name: Alico
alico.description: Alico, Inc. is a holding company in the United States owning Alico Citrus and Alico Water Resources. It owns major land holdings in Florida and announced plans to discontinue citrus crop operations due to disease and weather damage while maintaining agricultural land through leasing.

american-homes-4-rent.name: American Homes 4 Rent
american-homes-4-rent.description: American Homes 4 Rent, based in Las Vegas, Nevada, is a real estate investment trust that invests in single-family rental homes. It owns over 52,000 homes across 22 states, with major concentrations in Atlanta, Dallas-Fort Worth, and Charlotte.

asos.name: ASOS
asos.description: ASOS plc is a British online fast-fashion and cosmetic retailer founded in 2000 in London. It targets young adults and sells over 850 brands along with its own clothing and accessories. The company ships to 196 countries from fulfillment centers in the UK, US, and Europe.

aegion.name: Aegion
aegion.description: Azuria Water Solutions, formerly Aegion Corporation, is an American multinational company involved in construction, maintenance, protection, rehabilitation, engineering, and design of infrastructure projects. It serves industries including oil and gas, power plants, food manufacturing, water, and wastewater.

applied-genetic-technologies-corporation.name: Applied Genetic Technologies Corporation
applied-genetic-technologies-corporation.description: Applied Genetic Technologies Corporation was a publicly traded biotechnology company headquartered in Alachua, Florida. Founded in 1999, it was part of the NASDAQ Biotechnology Index. In 2019, it appointed Theresa G.H. Heah as Chief Medical Officer.

arrowhead-research.name: Arrowhead Research
arrowhead-research.description: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in Pasadena, California. It develops products using RNA interference mechanisms targeting hepatitis B, alpha 1-antitrypsin deficiency-related liver disease, and cardiovascular disease.

angang-steel-company.name: Angang Steel Company
angang-steel-company.description: Angang Steel Company Limited is a joint-stock company parented by Anshan Iron and Steel Group and supervised by the State Council of China. It is the second largest steel maker in Mainland China.

alpha-group-company.name: Alpha Group Company
alpha-group-company.description: Alpha Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese multinational conglomerate in animation, toys, mass media, and entertainment. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in China, it operates a Chinese webcomics site and an American film company, with an animation division in the US.

avg-technologies.name: AVG Technologies
avg-technologies.description: AVG Technologies B.V. is a cybersecurity brand developed by Avast, part of Gen Digital. It offers antivirus, secure browser, firewall, VPN, and performance software for multiple platforms, with many products offered as freeware.

albany-international.name: Albany International
albany-international.description: Albany International Corp. is an industrial-goods company based in Rochester, New Hampshire, United States. It produces machine clothing such as felts for paper manufacturing and textile processing, as well as composites for the aerospace industry. The company is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

ascential.name: Ascential
ascential.description: Ascential was a British-headquartered global company specializing in events, intelligence, and advisory services for marketing and financial technology industries. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Informa in October 2024.

altia.name: Altia
altia.description: Altia Oyj was a Finnish state-owned corporation based in Helsinki that produced, imported, exported, and marketed alcoholic beverages. It operated in several Nordic and Baltic countries and had production plants in Finland and Estonia. Its largest imported brands included Drostdy-Hof, Two Oceans, and Jack Daniel's.

alkem-laboratories.name: Alkem Laboratories
alkem-laboratories.description: Alkem Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. It specializes in generics and specialty pharmaceuticals, manufacturing and marketing pharmaceutical generics, formulations, and nutraceuticals across India and global markets.

aerie-pharmaceuticals.name: Aerie Pharmaceuticals
aerie-pharmaceuticals.description: Aerie Pharmaceuticals was an American clinical-stage pharmaceutical company focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapies for glaucoma and other eye diseases. Its lead products were once-daily therapies aimed at lowering intraocular pressure in patients with glaucoma or ocular hypertension.

affiliated-managers-group.name: Affiliated Managers Group
affiliated-managers-group.description: Affiliated Managers Group, Inc. is an American financial services firm founded in 1993 and headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida. It is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange and listed on the S&P 400.

agl-resources.name: AGL Resources
agl-resources.description: Southern Company Gas, formerly AGL Resources, is an American energy services holding company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It operates natural gas distribution, wholesale, retail, and midstream services and serves approximately 4.5 million utility customers.

appfolio.name: AppFolio
appfolio.description: AppFolio, Inc. is an American company founded in 2006 that provides software-as-a-service applications and services to the real estate industry. It is based in the United States and focuses on SaaS solutions for real estate professionals.

axalta-coating-systems.name: Axalta Coating Systems
axalta-coating-systems.description: Axalta Coating Systems Ltd. is an American company specializing in coatings for industrial applications, including automotive paints. It is based in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and incorporated in Bermuda. Axalta operates in 130 countries and serves over 100,000 customers worldwide.

admiral-group.name: Admiral Group
admiral-group.description: Admiral Group plc is a British financial services company headquartered in Cardiff, Wales. It markets several insurance brands and founded the price comparison service Confused.com, which it sold in 2021. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

adient.name: Adient
adient.description: Adient plc is an American, Irish-domiciled company that operates as the largest manufacturer of automotive seating worldwide. It is based in Plymouth, Michigan, United States. The company serves the automotive industry globally.

ameris-bancorp.name: Ameris Bancorp
ameris-bancorp.description: Ameris Bancorp is an American bank holding company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It operates full-service branches and mortgage-only locations across several southeastern states and offers online and mobile banking for consumers and businesses.

applovin.name: AppLovin
applovin.description: AppLovin Corporation is an American mobile technology company based in Palo Alto, California. Founded in 2012, it provides platforms for app marketing, monetization, analytics, and publishing, and invests in mobile game publishers.

advantest.name: Advantest
advantest.description: Advantest Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of automatic test equipment for the semiconductor industry, based in Tokyo. It produces test systems for memory, SoC, and RF, and measuring instruments for electronic systems including fiber optic and wireless communications.

a2a.name: A2A
a2a.description: A2A S.p.A. is an Italian company organized as a società per azioni that generates, distributes, and markets renewable energy, electricity, gas, integrated water supply, and waste management services. It has a significant presence in Northern Italy and energy facilities in Italy and Greece.

adore-beauty.name: Adore Beauty
adore-beauty.description: Adore Beauty is an Australian beauty and wellness retailer operating both online and through physical stores across Australia and New Zealand. Founded in 1999, it is headquartered in Melbourne, Victoria, and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

arch-capital-group.name: Arch Capital Group
arch-capital-group.description: Arch Capital Group Ltd. is a Bermuda-based public company that writes insurance, reinsurance, and mortgage insurance worldwide. It focuses on specialty lines and operates from 60 offices across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia.

ayvens.name: Ayvens
ayvens.description: Ayvens, formerly ALD Automotive, is a French fleet management and operational car leasing company. It is a majority-owned subsidiary of Société Générale and operates internationally with a presence in 42 countries.

aussie-broadband.name: Aussie Broadband
aussie-broadband.description: Aussie Broadband is an Australian telecommunications and internet retail service provider formed in 2008 after the amalgamation of Wideband Networks and Westvic Broadband.

aecom.name: AECOM
aecom.description: AECOM is an American multinational infrastructure consulting firm headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It provides consulting services related to construction and infrastructure projects.

affymetrix.name: Affymetrix
affymetrix.description: Affymetrix was an American biotechnology company based in Santa Clara, California, known for developing DNA microarray products. It is now a brand under Thermo Fisher Scientific, originating from its research and manufacturing operations.

aggreko.name: Aggreko
aggreko.description: Aggreko is a global supplier of mobile and modular power, temperature control equipment, and energy services headquartered in Glasgow, United Kingdom. Founded in 1962, it was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition in 2021.

arrival.name: Arrival
arrival.description: Arrival was a British electric vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Howald, Luxembourg, focusing on lightweight commercial vehicles. Its research and development took place in Banbury, Oxfordshire.

acadia-healthcare.name: Acadia Healthcare
acadia-healthcare.description: Acadia Healthcare Company, Inc. is an American for-profit behavioral healthcare services provider. It operates a network of over 225 facilities across the United States and Puerto Rico. The company focuses on behavioral healthcare.

american-eagle-outfitters.name: American Eagle Outfitters
american-eagle-outfitters.description: American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. is an American clothing and accessories retailer headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1977, it is the parent company of brands including Aerie, Unsubscribed, and Todd Snyder.

american-superconductor.name: American Superconductor
american-superconductor.description: American Superconductor Corporation is an American energy technologies company based in Ayer, Massachusetts. It specializes in superconductors for power systems, including high-temperature superconductor wire, motors, generators, and power electronics for wind farms and transmission.

ameriprise-financial.name: Ameriprise Financial
ameriprise-financial.description: Ameriprise Financial, Inc. is an American diversified financial services company and bank holding company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. It provides financial planning, wealth management, asset management, insurance, annuities, and estate planning services.

alembic-pharmaceuticals-ltd.name: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd
alembic-pharmaceuticals-ltd.description: Alembic Pharmaceuticals is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat. It manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products including active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations, with a presence in the macrolide anti-infective drug segment.

anker.name: Anker
anker.description: Anker Innovations Co., Ltd is a Chinese electronics manufacturer based in Changsha, Hunan. The company produces a wide range of consumer electronics including phone chargers, power banks, earbuds, 3D printers, and smart home devices. It is known for its diverse product portfolio in the consumer electronics industry.

arista-networks.name: Arista Networks
arista-networks.description: Arista Networks, Inc. is an American company providing client to cloud networking services for large data centers, AI, campus, and routing environments. It operates in the computer networking industry. The company is based in the United States.

aristocrat-leisure.name: Aristocrat Leisure
aristocrat-leisure.description: Aristocrat Leisure Limited is an Australian gambling machine manufacturer headquartered in North Ryde, Sydney. It develops and supplies electronic gambling machines, casino management systems, online gambling technology, and social casino games. The company has offices in the UK, Europe, and the US.

aaon.name: AAON
aaon.description: AAON, Inc. manufactures heating, ventilation, and air conditioning equipment for commercial and industrial indoor environments. The company is headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, with manufacturing facilities in Texas, Missouri, and Oregon. It operates in the central heating industry.

atacadao.name: Atacadão
atacadao.description: Atacadão is a Brazilian chain of warehouse stores operating in Brazil and also running hypermarkets in Morocco and France. It was established by Alcides Parizotto and later acquired by Carrefour in 2007. The company competes with Assaí Atacadista in the retail sector.

avis-budget-group.name: Avis Budget Group
avis-budget-group.description: Avis Budget Group, Inc. is an American car rental agency holding company headquartered in Parsippany, New Jersey. It is one of the three major rental car holding companies in the United States and owns brands including Avis Car Rental, Budget Rent a Car, and Zipcar.

acco-brands.name: ACCO Brands
acco-brands.description: ACCO Brands Corporation is an American producer of branded consumer, academic, business, and technology products. Headquartered in Lake Zurich, Illinois, it sells its products in more than 100 countries worldwide.

adt-inc.name: ADT Inc.
adt-inc.description: ADT Inc. is an American security company providing residential and small business electronic security, fire protection, and alarm monitoring services in the US and Canada. Its corporate head office is in Boca Raton, Florida.

aes-corporation.name: AES Corporation
aes-corporation.description: The AES Corporation is an American utility and power generation company headquartered in Arlington, Virginia. It operates globally and is recognized as a Fortune 500 power company. AES is involved in electricity generation and supply.

agl-energy.name: AGL Energy
agl-energy.description: AGL Energy Ltd is an Australian public company involved in electricity and gas generation and retailing for residential and commercial customers. It is one of the three major retailers in the National Electricity Market and is Australia's largest electricity generator.

aimco.name: Aimco
aimco.description: Apartment Investment and Management Company, known as Aimco, is a publicly traded American real estate investment trust. It owns apartment communities and a hotel as part of its real estate portfolio.

aopen.name: AOpen
aopen.description: AOpen is a Taiwanese electronics manufacturer that produces computers and computer parts. It originated as the Open System Business Unit of Acer Computer Inc.

aware-inc.name: Aware, Inc.
aware-inc.description: Aware, Inc. is a biometrics software and services company based near Boston, Massachusetts.

aaeon.name: AAEON
aaeon.description: AAEON Technology Inc. is a Taiwanese manufacturer specializing in industrial computer and embedding systems. Founded in 1992, it became one of Taiwan's 1,000 largest manufacturers by 1998. The company operates in the computer industry.

abcellera.name: AbCellera
abcellera.description: AbCellera Biologics Inc. is a biotechnology company based in Vancouver, British Columbia. It discovers and develops antibody therapeutics and is known for its role in DARPA's Pandemic Prevention Platform. Its technology platform was initially developed at the University of British Columbia.

asia-vital-components-taiwan.name: Asia Vital Components (Taiwan)
asia-vital-components-taiwan.description: Asia Vital Components Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese electronics company producing computer cooling solutions. Founded in 1991, it has been listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange since 2002 and operates in the electronics industry.

align-technology.name: Align Technology
align-technology.description: Align Technology, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, that manufactures 3D digital scanners and Invisalign clear aligners used in orthodontics. It produces aligners in Mexico, Poland, and China, and scanners in Israel and China. The company is best known for its Invisalign clear aligner system.

aptar.name: Aptar
aptar.description: AptarGroup, Inc., known as Aptar, is a United States-based global manufacturer of consumer dispensing packaging and drug delivery devices. The company operates manufacturing facilities in 18 countries worldwide.

arcadia-biosciences-united-states.name: Arcadia Biosciences (United States)
arcadia-biosciences-united-states.description: Arcadia Biosciences is a publicly traded American agricultural biotechnology company headquartered in Davis, California. It focuses on developing traits to enhance crop quality and productivity and is partly owned by Moral Compass Corporation.

axway-software.name: Axway Software
axway-software.description: Axway Software is a French-American publicly held information technology company. It provides software tools for enterprise software, application integration, business monitoring, analytics, mobile app development, and web API management.

abengoa.name: Abengoa
abengoa.description: Abengoa, S.A. was a Spanish multinational company focused on green infrastructure, energy, and water sectors. Founded in 1941 and based in Seville, Spain, it faced insolvency in 2021 after financial difficulties and regulatory issues. It was one of the largest corporate collapses in Spanish history.

abertis.name: Abertis
abertis.description: Abertis Infraestructuras, S.A. is a Spanish multinational corporation that manages toll roads worldwide. Headquartered in Madrid, it operates over 8,600 kilometers of toll roads. In 2018, it was acquired by a consortium including Italian, Spanish, and German companies.

american-airlines.name: American Airlines
american-airlines.description: American Airlines, Inc. is a major U.S. airline headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas. It operates an extensive international and domestic network with thousands of daily flights to nearly 350 destinations in 48 countries. The airline is a founding member of the Oneworld alliance.

astro-malaysia-holdings.name: Astro Malaysia Holdings
astro-malaysia-holdings.description: Astro Malaysia Holdings Berhad is a Malaysian media and entertainment holding company. It started as a paid digital satellite radio and television service and serves millions of homes, enterprises, radio listeners, digital visitors, and shoppers across its platforms.

actavis.name: Actavis
actavis.description: Actavis Generics is a global pharmaceutical company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with administrative offices in Parsippany-Troy Hills, New Jersey. It focuses on acquiring, developing, manufacturing, and marketing branded pharmaceuticals, generics, over-the-counter medicines, and biologics.

acushnet-company.name: Acushnet Company
acushnet-company.description: The Acushnet Company is an American company focused on the golf market. It operates a series of brands that manufacture golf equipment, clothing, and accessories.

alpargatas-s-a.name: Alpargatas S.A.
alpargatas-s-a.description: Alpargatas S.A. is a Brazilian manufacturing company headquartered in São Paulo. Established in 1907, it is one of the largest companies in Brazil specializing in footwear and canvas products. The company operates in the industrial manufacturing sector.

acea.name: Acea
acea.description: Acea Spa is an Italian multiutility company managing networks and services in water, energy, and environmental sectors. It is the main national operator in the water sector, serving about 10 million people, primarily in regions including Lazio, Liguria, Tuscany, and others, as well as some Latin American countries.

acotel-group.name: Acotel Group
acotel-group.description: The Acotel Group S.p.A. is a global telecommunications company headquartered in Formello, Italy. Founded in 2000, it leads a group operating in ICT, focusing on mobile telecommunications, value-added services, mobile messaging, media solutions, advertising, and security systems for large companies.

azimut-holding.name: Azimut Holding
azimut-holding.description: Azimut Holding is an independent global group operating in asset management, wealth management, investment banking, and fintech. It serves both private and corporate clients.

avid-technology.name: Avid Technology
avid-technology.description: Avid Technology, Inc. is a global technology company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts. Founded in 1987, it develops software, SaaS, and hardware products mainly used in the media and entertainment industry.

agnico-eagle-mines.name: Agnico Eagle Mines
agnico-eagle-mines.description: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited is a Canadian gold producer with operations in Canada, Finland, Australia, and Mexico, and exploration activities in the United States. The company has paid a cash dividend every year since 1983 and maintains a policy of no-forward gold sales.

antero-resources.name: Antero Resources
antero-resources.description: Antero Resources Corporation is an American hydrocarbon exploration company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It operates exclusively in the Appalachian Basin using hydraulic fracturing to extract reserves. The company is organized in Delaware.

agrium.name: Agrium
agrium.description: Agrium Inc. was a major retail supplier of agricultural products and services across North America, South America, and Australia. It was also a wholesale producer and marketer of major agricultural nutrients and specialty fertilizers in North America.

abrau-durso.name: Abrau-Durso
abrau-durso.description: Abrau-Durso is a Russian wine company located in the village of Abrau-Dyurso near Lake Abrau, the Dyurso River, and the Black Sea Coast. It is situated about 15 kilometers west of the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk.

airasia-x.name: AirAsia X
airasia-x.description: AirAsia X Berhad is a Malaysian long-haul, low-cost airline and a subsidiary of the AirAsia Group. Established in 2006, it was initially known as FlyAsianXpress and rebranded as AirAsia X in 2007. The airline operates international flights, including its first route from Kuala Lumpur to Gold Coast, Australia.

airasia.name: AirAsia
airasia.description: AirAsia Group Berhad is a Malaysian multinational low-cost airline headquartered near Kuala Lumpur. Founded in 1993 and operational since 1996, it is the largest airline in Malaysia by fleet size and destinations, serving over 166 destinations in 25 countries from its primary hub at Kuala Lumpur International Airport.

air-products-chemicals.name: Air Products & Chemicals
air-products-chemicals.description: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc. is a U.S.-based international corporation that sells gases and chemicals for industrial use. The company is headquartered in Trexlertown, Pennsylvania, in the Lehigh Valley region of eastern Pennsylvania.

ajinomoto.name: Ajinomoto
ajinomoto.description: Ajinomoto Co., Inc. is a Japanese multinational corporation producing seasonings, cooking oils, frozen foods, beverages, sweeteners, amino acids, insulating films, and pharmaceuticals. Its original product, Aji-No-Moto monosodium glutamate, was first introduced in 1909. The company is headquartered in Chūō, Tokyo.

ambank.name: AmBank
ambank.description: AmBank Group, comprising AMMB Holdings Berhad, is one of Malaysia's largest banking groups. Its core businesses include retail banking, wholesale banking, Islamic banking, and life and general insurance.

artisan-partners.name: Artisan Partners
artisan-partners.description: Artisan Partners is an American asset management company headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. It operates offices internationally in Dublin, Hong Kong, London, Singapore, and Sydney.

al-bilad-bank.name: Al Bilad Bank
al-bilad-bank.description: Bank Albilad is an Islamic bank established in Saudi Arabia in 2004. It provides financial services compliant with Islamic banking principles.

altairnano.name: Altairnano
altairnano.description: Altair Nanotechnologies is an American company specializing in energy storage systems. It develops and manufactures advanced lithium-ion batteries and energy management solutions.

altair-engineering.name: Altair Engineering
altair-engineering.description: Altair Engineering Inc. is an American multinational information technology company headquartered in Troy, Michigan. It provides software and cloud solutions for simulation, IoT, high performance computing, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. The company operates in the technology sector.

aktia-bank.name: Aktia Bank
aktia-bank.description: Aktia Bank is a mid-sized financial services company in Finland, headquartered in Helsinki. It provides digital and personalized services in banking, life insurance, and asset management across several Finnish regions. Its shares are listed on NASDAQ Helsinki.

alumina-limited.name: Alumina Limited
alumina-limited.description: Alumina Limited is an Australian holding company spun off from Western Mining Corporation in 2002. Its sole asset is a 40% shareholding in Alcoa World Alumina & Chemicals. In 2024, Alcoa acquired Alumina Limited.

aluminum-corporation-of-china.name: Aluminum Corporation of China
aluminum-corporation-of-china.description: Aluminum Corporation of China is a Chinese state-owned enterprise and the top-level holding company for China's non-ferrous metals industry. It is wholly owned by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council. The company is responsible for policy execution, strategic asset oversight, and international resource coordination.

amada-co.name: Amada Co
amada-co.description: Amada Co., Ltd. is a large Japanese manufacturer of metal processing equipment and machinery based in Kanagawa. The company produces metal cutting, forming, shearing, and punching machines, and also develops factory automation systems and electronic equipment. Its products serve industries such as automotive, computer, camera, and electric appliances.

ambac.name: Ambac
ambac.description: The Ambac Financial Group, Inc. is an American holding company headquartered in Lower Manhattan, New York City. Its subsidiaries provide financial guarantee products such as bond insurance globally. Ambac Assurance guarantees public finance and structured finance obligations and is regulated by Wisconsin's insurance commission.

amcor.name: Amcor
amcor.description: Amcor plc is a multinational packaging company founded in Australia. It develops and produces flexible packaging, rigid containers, specialty cartons, closures, and services for various industries including food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and medical devices.

amdocs.name: Amdocs
amdocs.description: Amdocs Limited is a multinational telecommunications technology and software company headquartered in Chesterfield, Missouri. It specializes in software and services for communications, media, digital enterprises, and financial services providers. Founded in 1982, it is publicly traded on Nasdaq.

ameren.name: Ameren
ameren.description: Ameren Corporation is an American power company based in St. Louis, Missouri. Created in 1997 by the merger of Union Electric Company and Central Illinois Public Service Company, it serves electric and natural gas customers across Missouri and Illinois.

a-o-smith.name: A. O. Smith
a-o-smith.description: A. O. Smith Corporation is an American manufacturer of residential and commercial water heaters and boilers. It is the largest manufacturer and marketer of water heaters in North America and also supplies water treatment products in Asia with multiple manufacturing locations worldwide.

aar-corp.name: AAR Corp
aar-corp.description: AAR CORP. is an American provider of aircraft maintenance services to commercial and government customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Wood Dale, Illinois, and operates in 30 countries with about 7,000 employees.

abm-industries.name: ABM Industries
abm-industries.hq: Fred F. French Building, United States
abm-industries.description: ABM Industries Inc. is an American facility management provider founded in 1909 in San Francisco, California. It offers services including electrical, lighting, energy, HVAC, janitorial, landscaping, parking, and transportation management.

aci-worldwide.name: ACI Worldwide
aci-worldwide.description: ACI Worldwide is a digital payments software company headquartered in Elkhorn, Nebraska. It processes billions of transactions daily for customers in 94 countries, providing secure payment solutions for banks, merchants, and other financial institutions.

allied-telesis-holdings.name: Allied Telesis Holdings
allied-telesis-holdings.description: Allied Telesis Holdings K.K., formerly Allied Telesyn, is a network infrastructure and telecommunications company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with branches in San Jose, California. Established in 1987, it provides Ethernet and IP access equipment and IP triple play networks over copper and fiber infrastructure.

abiomed.name: AbioMed
abiomed.description: Abiomed, Inc. is a medical device technology company headquartered in Danvers, Massachusetts, operating as a stand-alone business within Johnson & Johnson's MedTech Segment. It develops and manufactures temporary external and implantable mechanical circulatory support devices and has offices in multiple cities worldwide.

acacia-research.name: Acacia Research
acacia-research.description: Acacia Research Corporation is a publicly traded American company based in New York City. It acquires and operates businesses in technology, energy, and industrial/manufacturing sectors. The company has a strategic relationship with Starboard Value, LP, its controlling shareholder.

acadia-pharmaceuticals.name: Acadia Pharmaceuticals
acadia-pharmaceuticals.description: Acadia Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Del Mar, California. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry.

american-water-works.name: American Water Works
american-water-works.description: American Water Works Company, Inc. is an American public utility company providing water and wastewater services in the United States through its subsidiaries.

acme-united-corporation.name: Acme United Corporation
acme-united-corporation.description: Acme United Corporation is an American supplier of cutting, measuring, and safety products for school, home, office, hardware, and industrial markets. Founded as a partnership in 1867, it is incorporated in Connecticut and publicly traded on the NYSE American.

acom.name: Acom
acom.description: Acom is one of Japan's largest consumer loan companies. Founded by Masao Kinoshita, it also issues credit cards. The company name stands for Affection, Confidence, and Moderation.

acorda-therapeutics.name: Acorda Therapeutics
acorda-therapeutics.description: Acorda Therapeutics, Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in Pearl River, New York. It develops therapies for neurological disorders and manufactures drugs including Inbrija and Ampyra in the United States.

actions-technology.name: Actions Technology
actions-technology.description: Actions Technology Co. Ltd. is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company founded in 2000 and headquartered in Zhuhai, Guangdong province, with offices in Shanghai and Shenzhen. It designs system on chips (SoCs) for tablets, digital audio players, photo viewers, and related products.

actuant.name: Actuant
