actuant.description: Enerpac Tool Group Corp., formerly Actuant Corporation, is a company founded in 1910 and headquartered in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, United States. It operates as a conglomerate with a history dating back over a century.

adacel.name: Adacel
adacel.description: Adacel Technologies Limited is an Australian air traffic management company that develops and implements air traffic management systems, as well as air traffic control simulation and training solutions.

adcock-ingram.name: Adcock Ingram
adcock-ingram.description: Adcock Ingram is a South African pharmaceutical manufacturer listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange. It manufactures and markets healthcare products to both private and public sectors.

adelphia-communications-corporation.name: Adelphia Communications Corporation
adelphia-communications-corporation.description: Adelphia Communications Corporation was an American cable television company headquartered in Coudersport, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1952, it grew to serve over two million subscribers and expanded into high-speed internet, phone services, and voice messaging for businesses.

advance-auto-parts.name: Advance Auto Parts
advance-auto-parts.description: Advance Auto Parts is an American automotive aftermarket parts provider headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. It serves both professional installers and do-it-yourself customers.

advanced-energy.name: Advanced Energy
advanced-energy.description: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It develops precision power conversion, measurement, and control technologies for manufacturing semiconductors, flat panel displays, data storage products, telecommunications equipment, and more.

advantage-energy.name: Advantage Energy
advantage-energy.description: Advantage Energy Ltd. is a Canadian oil and gas company based in Calgary, Alberta. It focuses on developing its Montney fossil gas and liquids resource play to provide Canadian energy and is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

advaxis.name: Advaxis
advaxis.description: Advaxis Immunotherapies Inc. was an American biotechnology company focused on immunotherapies based on a genetically engineered platform using Listeria monocytogenes. It merged with Ayala Pharmaceuticals, with the new company starting operations in January 2023.

aeolian-investment-fund-s-a.name: Aeolian Investment Fund S.A.
aeolian-investment-fund-s-a.description: Aeolian Investment Fund S.A. is a Greek company listed on the Athens Stock Exchange that invests in other Greek companies. It operates within Greece's financial market.

aerohive-networks.name: Aerohive Networks
aerohive-networks.description: Aerohive Networks, Inc. was an American multinational computer networking equipment company headquartered in Milpitas, California. Founded in 2006, it provided wireless networking solutions to medium-sized and larger businesses worldwide.

agenus.name: Agenus
agenus.description: Agenus Inc. is a biotechnology company based in Lexington, Massachusetts, focused on immunotherapy including immuno-oncology. It develops checkpoint modulators, patient-specific anti-cancer vaccines, and vaccine adjuvants.

agile-group-holdings-limited.name: Agile Group Holdings Limited
agile-group-holdings-limited.description: Agile Property Holdings Limited is a land developer focused on Guangdong Province, China. Established in 1985 as a furniture maker, it entered the property business in 1992 and was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2005.

aiful.name: Aiful
aiful.description: AIFUL Corporation is one of the largest Japanese consumer finance companies based in Kyoto. It had to restructure its debt after failing to make a loan payment.

ametek.name: Ametek
ametek.description: AMETEK, Inc. is an American multinational conglomerate that designs and manufactures electronic instruments and electromechanical devices. It has headquarters in the United States and operates over 150 sites worldwide.

alabama-power.name: Alabama Power
alabama-power.description: Alabama Power Company is headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, and provides electricity service to 1.4 million customers in southern Alabama. It is one of four U.S. utilities operated by the Southern Company.

alarm-com-inc.name: Alarm.com, Inc.
alarm-com-inc.description: Alarm.com, Inc. is an American technology company based in Tysons, Virginia, providing cloud-based services for remote control, home automation, and alarm monitoring. It was founded in 2000 as a spinoff from MicroStrategy.

alaska-communications.name: Alaska Communications
alaska-communications.description: Alaska Communications is a telecommunications corporation headquartered in Anchorage, Alaska. It was the first provider in Alaska to maintain a 3G wireless network and owns infrastructure for wireless, internet, and phone services. Its operations include advanced data networks and an underwater fiber optic system.

alexander-s.name: Alexander's
alexander-s.description: Alexander's, Inc. is a New York City-based real estate investment trust owning seven properties in the New York metropolitan area. Founded in 1928 as a department store chain, it is controlled by Vornado Realty Trust as of 2026.

algonquin-power.name: Algonquin Power
algonquin-power.description: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. is a Canadian investor-owned regulated utility company with assets in North America, Bermuda, and Chile. It provides water, wastewater, natural gas, and electricity services through subsidiaries including Liberty Utilities and Bermuda Electric Light Company.

amkor-technology.name: Amkor Technology
amkor-technology.description: Amkor Technology, Inc. is an American semiconductor product packaging and test services provider. Founded in 1968, it is headquartered in Arizona, having moved there in 2005. The company has locations in Chandler and Tempe.

aliansce-shopping-centers.name: Aliansce Shopping Centers
aliansce-shopping-centers.description: Aliansce Sonae was the second-largest shopping mall developer and manager in Brazil. Founded in 2004 as a joint venture between Nacional Iguatemi and GGP, it merged with Sonae Sierra Brasil in 2019 to form Alliances Sonae, becoming the largest shopping center manager in Brazil.

alimera-sciences.name: Alimera Sciences
alimera-sciences.description: Alimera Sciences, Inc. was a biopharmaceutical sales company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. It specialized in the commercialization and sales of prescription ophthalmic pharmaceuticals, focusing on diseases affecting the retina.

alkermes.name: Alkermes
alkermes.description: Alkermes plc is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines for psychiatric and neurological disorders. Founded in 1987, it is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with an R&D center in Massachusetts and a manufacturing facility in Ohio. In 2011, Alkermes merged with Elan Drug Technologies.

allegiance-mining.name: Allegiance Mining
allegiance-mining.description: Allegiance Mining NL is an Australian mining company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange since 1993. It operates in the mining industry and is based in Australia.

alliancebernstein.name: AllianceBernstein
alliancebernstein.description: AllianceBernstein Holding L.P. is an American asset-management firm providing investment management and research services worldwide. It serves institutional, high-net-worth, and retail investors.

alliant-energy.name: Alliant Energy
alliant-energy.description: Alliant Energy Corporation is a public utility holding company headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin. It provides power services in the states of Iowa and Wisconsin in the United States.

allied-bank-limited.name: Allied Bank Limited
allied-bank-limited.description: Allied Bank Limited is a Pakistani commercial bank based in Lahore, Punjab. It operates as a subsidiary of the Ibrahim Group.

allot-ltd.name: Allot Ltd
allot-ltd.description: Allot Ltd., formerly Allot Communications, is an Israeli high-tech company specializing in telecommunications software. The company is headquartered in Hod Hasharon, Israel.

allscripts.name: Allscripts
allscripts.description: Veradigm Inc., formerly known as Allscripts, is a publicly traded American company providing practice management and electronic health record technology to healthcare providers. It serves over 180,000 physicians and has products in thousands of hospitals and care organizations.

alpek.name: Alpek
alpek.description: Alpek S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican chemical manufacturing company headquartered in San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León. It is a leading producer of PET, PTA, and the sole polypropylene producer in Mexico, and is the largest chemical company in Mexico.

alsea.name: Alsea
alsea.description: Alsea, S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican multi-brand restaurant operator based in Mexico City. Founded in 1997, it operates fast-food, casual dining, and cafeteria chains across Mexico, South America, and Europe.

altos-computer-systems.name: Altos Computer Systems
altos-computer-systems.hq: San Francisco Bay Area, United States
altos-computer-systems.description: Altos Computer Systems was founded in 1977 and specialized in small multi-user computers based on CP/M, Unix, and Xenix. The company went public in 1982, raising $59 million, and traded under the symbol ALTO.

amtrust-financial-services-inc.name: AmTrust Financial Services, Inc.
amtrust-financial-services-inc.description: AmTrust Financial Services, Inc. is a New York City-based multinational property and casualty insurance company. It offers various insurance products including workers’ compensation and cyber liability, operating mainly in North America, the UK, and Europe through subsidiaries.

amarin-corporation.name: Amarin Corporation
amarin-corporation.description: Amarin Corporation is an Irish-American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland and Bridgewater, New Jersey. Founded in 1993, it develops and markets medicines for cardiovascular disease, including the prescription drug Vascepa.

ambarella-inc.name: Ambarella Inc.
ambarella-inc.description: Ambarella, Inc. is an American fabless semiconductor design company specializing in low-power, high-definition video compression, image processing, and computer vision processors. Its products are used in applications such as video security, autonomous driving, and robotics.

amcol-international-corporation.name: Amcol International Corporation
amcol-international-corporation.description: AMCOL International Corporation is a company based in Hoffman Estates, Illinois that mines, processes, and distributes chemical products. It also provides clays used as moisture barriers in commercial construction.

ameriserv-financial.name: AmeriServ Financial
ameriserv-financial.description: AmeriServ Financial, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Johnstown, Pennsylvania. It operates AmeriServ Financial Bank along with trust, financial services, and life insurance subsidiaries, and maintains 16 automated teller machines.

american-axle.name: American Axle
american-axle.description: Dauch Corporation, formerly American Axle & Manufacturing, Inc., is an American manufacturer of automobile driveline and drivetrain components headquartered in Detroit, Michigan.

american-financial-group.name: American Financial Group
american-financial-group.description: American Financial Group, Inc. is a financial services holding company headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. Its primary businesses include insurance and investments.

american-national-insurance-company.name: American National Insurance Company
american-national-insurance-company.description: American National Insurance Company is a major American insurance corporation based in Galveston, Texas. It operates in all 50 U.S. states and Puerto Rico and was acquired by Brookfield Reinsurance in May 2022.

american-pathology-partners.name: American Pathology Partners
american-pathology-partners.description: American Pathology Partners, Inc. is a privately held medical laboratory company based in Nashville, Tennessee. It operates a nationwide network of pathology laboratories serving physician offices, hospitals, and surgery centers. The company offers sub-specialized anatomic and molecular pathology services and has laboratory facilities in Colorado, North Carolina, and Florida.

american-river-bank.name: American River Bank
american-river-bank.description: American River Bank was a community bank founded in 1983 serving the Greater Sacramento area in California. It offered business and personal financial services through ten branches in Northern California. The bank was a wholly owned subsidiary of American River Bankshares.

american-science-and-engineering.name: American Science and Engineering
american-science-and-engineering.description: American Science and Engineering Inc. (AS&E) is an American manufacturer of advanced X-ray equipment and related technologies founded in 1958. The company initially developed technology for NASA and contributed to the discovery of the first extra-solar source of X-rays. AS&E invented backscatter technology and body scanners used for security screening.

american-woodmark.name: American Woodmark
american-woodmark.description: American Woodmark Corporation is a kitchen and bath cabinet manufacturer headquartered in Winchester, Virginia. It operates multiple manufacturing facilities across several U.S. states including Arizona, Georgia, and Virginia. The company also maintains service centers throughout the country.

amidar-the-israeli-national-public-housi.name: Amidar The Israeli National Public Housing Company
amidar-the-israeli-national-public-housi.legal_name: Amidar The Israeli National Public Housing Company
amidar-the-israeli-national-public-housi.description: Amidar is a state-owned housing company in Israel. It operates in the real estate sector providing public housing services.

listings.name: Amidar The Israeli National Public Housing Company

amphenol.name: Amphenol
amphenol.description: Amphenol Corporation is headquartered in Wallingford, Connecticut, and is a major designer, manufacturer, and marketer of electrical, electronic, and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems. Its products include antennas, sensors, and various types of cables.

ampol.name: Ampol
ampol.description: Ampol Limited is an Australian petroleum company headquartered in Alexandria, New South Wales. It is the largest transport energy distributor and retailer in Australia with over 1,800 service stations. Ampol also operates in New Zealand through its subsidiary Z Energy.

amreit.name: Amreit
amreit.description: AmREIT, Inc. was a real estate investment trust that invested in shopping centers in Texas and Atlanta, Georgia. The company also managed real estate investment funds for high net worth individuals and partnered with JPMorgan Chase and Goldman Sachs. It was based in the United States.

amrep-corporation.name: Amrep Corporation
amrep-corporation.description: AMREP Corporation is a real estate and media services company based in Princeton, New Jersey, United States. Founded in 1961 as The American Realty and Petroleum Corporation, it operates in the real estate sector.

anabuki-kosan.name: Anabuki Kosan
anabuki-kosan.description: Anabuki Kosan Inc. is a Japanese real estate company established in 1964 and headquartered in Takamatsu, Kagawa Prefecture. It was formerly part of the Anabuki Construction group and markets condominiums under the Alpha and Alpha Smart brands.

analogic-corporation.name: Analogic Corporation
analogic-corporation.description: Analogic Corporation is an American multinational specializing in healthcare technology and aviation security industries. It produces CT scan, digital mammography, and MRI equipment, and develops baggage screening and motion control technologies for airports.

anaplan.name: Anaplan
anaplan.description: Anaplan is a business planning software company headquartered in Miami, Florida. It sells subscriptions for cloud-based business-planning software and provides data to support decision-making.

angie-s-list.name: Angie's List
angie-s-list.description: Angi Inc. is an internet services company formed in 2017 by merging Angie's List and HomeAdvisor. It originated from Angie's List, an American home services website founded in 1995 that allows users to read and publish crowd-sourced reviews of local businesses and contractors.

anthera-pharmaceuticals.name: Anthera Pharmaceuticals
anthera-pharmaceuticals.description: Anthera Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company focused on developing products to treat cystic fibrosis, inflammation, and autoimmune diseases. Its leading drug candidate Liprotamase is in Phase 3 trials for exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, and A-623 is in Phase 2 trials for IgA nephropathy.

ams-osram-ag.name: ams OSRAM AG
ams-osram-ag.description: ams OSRAM AG is an Austrian semiconductor manufacturer headquartered in Premstätten, Austria, with a co-headquarters in Munich, Germany. The company develops and produces intelligent sensors and emitter components.

apollo-tyres.name: Apollo Tyres
apollo-tyres.description: Apollo Tyres Limited is an Indian multinational tyre manufacturer headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana. Incorporated in 1972, it operates five manufacturing units in India and others in the Netherlands and Hungary, generating most of its revenue from India and Europe.

applied-industrial-technologies.name: Applied Industrial Technologies
applied-industrial-technologies.description: Applied Industrial Technologies, Inc. is a global company based in the United States that distributes bearings, power transmission products, engineered fluid power components, and other industrial supplies. It also provides engineering, design, and system integration services for industrial and fluid power applications.

applied-micro-circuits-corporation.name: Applied Micro Circuits Corporation
applied-micro-circuits-corporation.description: Applied Micro Circuits Corporation was a fabless semiconductor company in the United States that designed network and embedded Power ISA, server processor ARM, optical transport, and storage products.

apricus-biosciences.name: Apricus Biosciences
apricus-biosciences.description: Apricus Biosciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in San Diego, United States, focused on advancing innovative medicines in urology and rheumatology.

arab-national-bank.name: Arab National Bank
arab-national-bank.description: Arab National Bank is a major bank headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and listed on the Saudi Stock Exchange. It is among the top ten largest banks in the Middle East and has 156 branches in Saudi Arabia.

arabian-shield-cooperative-insurance-com.name: Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company
arabian-shield-cooperative-insurance-com.description: Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company is an insurance company operating within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

arcimoto.name: Arcimoto
arcimoto.description: Arcimoto, Inc. is an electric vehicle company headquartered in Eugene, Oregon, United States. It designs, manufactures, and sells the FUV, a tandem two-seat, three-wheeled electric vehicle, along with its four variations.

arena-pharmaceuticals.name: Arena Pharmaceuticals
arena-pharmaceuticals.description: Arena Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in San Diego, United States, developing small molecule drugs for multiple therapeutic areas. It has investigational clinical programs for pulmonary arterial hypertension, inflammatory indications, and pain associated with Crohn's disease.

ares-management.name: Ares Management
ares-management.description: Ares Management Corporation is a global alternative investment manager founded in 1997 and based in the United States. It operates in credit, private equity, and real estate markets with offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

argo-investments.name: Argo Investments
argo-investments.description: Argo Investments Limited is an Australian listed investment company trading on the Australian Stock Exchange. It holds a diversified portfolio of shares selected for profitability and long-term growth and is the second largest listed investment company in Australia as of 2007.

arlington-asset-investment.name: Arlington Asset Investment
arlington-asset-investment.description: Arlington Asset Investment Corp. is a mortgage real estate investment trust based in McLean, Virginia. The firm primarily invests in mortgage-related assets and residential real estate. It operates as an investment company focused on real estate finance.

arotech-corporation.name: Arotech Corporation
arotech-corporation.description: Arotech Corporation is a defense and security products and services company in the United States. It designs and manufactures products for military and non-military air and ground vehicles, interactive simulation, and military batteries and charging systems. The company operates through two main divisions: interactive simulation and batteries and power systems.

arthur-j-gallagher-co.name: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.
arthur-j-gallagher-co.description: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. is an American insurance brokerage and risk management services company headquartered in Rolling Meadows, Illinois. Founded in 1927, it provides insurance brokerage and risk management services, including processing workers compensation and automobile insurance claims.

asbury-automotive-group.name: Asbury Automotive Group
asbury-automotive-group.description: Asbury Automotive Group is an American company based near Atlanta that operates auto dealerships across the United States. Founded in 1995, it is recognized as a major player in the automotive retail sector.

ashot-ashkelon-industries-ltd.name: Ashot - Ashkelon Industries Ltd.
ashot-ashkelon-industries-ltd.description: Ashot Ashkelon Industries Ltd is an Israeli manufacturer headquartered in Ashkelon. It produces build-to-print products such as gears, transmissions, and gearboxes for aerospace, military, and automotive industries. The company employs around 560 people.

asphere-innovations.name: Asphere Innovations
asphere-innovations.description: Asphere Innovations is a tech holding company and online game operator based in Bangkok, Thailand. It operates the Playpark gaming platform across Southeast Asia, including Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore, and Malaysia.

associated-banc-corp.name: Associated Banc-Corp
associated-banc-corp.description: Associated Banc-Corp is a regional bank holding company headquartered in Green Bay, Wisconsin. It provides retail and commercial banking, commercial real estate lending, private banking, and specialized financial services across multiple Midwestern states and other US regions.

assura-group.name: Assura Group
assura-group.description: Assura is a British property business headquartered in Altrincham, Greater Manchester. It focuses on investing in buildings used for healthcare and owns and operates over 600 general practitioner and primary healthcare buildings in the UK as of 2025.

assurant.name: Assurant
assurant.description: Assurant, Inc. is a global provider of risk management products and services headquartered in Atlanta. It offers specialty insurance products in property, casualty, extended device protection, and insurance sectors. The company operates mainly through its Global Housing and Global Lifestyle segments.

asure-software.name: Asure Software
asure-software.description: Asure Software, Inc. is a software company that rebranded from Forgent Networks in 2007. It offers human capital management solutions including payroll, time and attendance, talent management, human resource management, benefits administration, and insurance services.

athenahealth.name: athenahealth
athenahealth.description: Athenahealth, Inc. is a privately held American company providing cloud-based healthcare technology and network-enabled services. Its main product, athenaOne, integrates electronic health records, practice management, medical billing, and patient engagement tools for ambulatory practices.

atlantic-power-corporation.name: Atlantic Power Corporation
atlantic-power-corporation.description: Atlantic Power Corporation, headquartered in Dedham, Massachusetts, is a power generation and infrastructure company with assets in the United States and Canada. It generates power through hydro, natural gas, biomass, and coal-fired plants and was acquired by I Squared Capital in 2021.

atlantis-casino-resort-spa.name: Atlantis Casino Resort Spa
atlantis-casino-resort-spa.description: The Atlantis Casino Resort Spa is a hotel and casino located in Reno, Nevada, owned by Monarch Casino & Resort, Inc. It features three hotel towers with 824 guest rooms and a casino floor of 64,814 square feet. The property has undergone nearly $150 million in upgrades.

atmos-energy.name: Atmos Energy
atmos-energy.description: Atmos Energy Corporation, headquartered in Dallas, Texas, is one of the largest natural-gas-only distributors in the United States. It serves about three million customers across over 1,400 communities in nine states from the Blue Ridge Mountains to the Rocky Mountains.

atwood-oceanics.name: Atwood Oceanics
atwood-oceanics.description: Atwood Oceanics, Inc. was an offshore drilling contractor headquartered in Houston, Texas. The company operated in the petroleum industry and was acquired by Ensco plc in October 2017.

aurico-gold.name: AuRico Gold
aurico-gold.description: AuRico Gold was a Canadian intermediate gold mining and exploration company that operated primarily in Mexico until August 2011. It also held assets in silver and copper and reached intermediate gold producer status after Northgate Minerals agreed to be taken over.

audioboom.name: AudioBoom
audioboom.description: AudioBoom PLC is a UK-based on-demand audio and podcasting distribution platform. It provides business-to-business services to the radio, media, and podcast industries.

aurobindo-pharma.name: Aurobindo Pharma
aurobindo-pharma.description: Aurobindo Pharma Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company based in Hyderabad with U.S. headquarters in New Jersey. It manufactures generic pharmaceuticals and active pharmaceutical ingredients across six major therapeutic areas and markets products in over 125 countries.

australian-agricultural-company.name: Australian Agricultural Company
australian-agricultural-company.description: The Australian Agricultural Company (AACo) is a public-listed Australian company owning and operating feedlots and farms covering about seven million hectares in Queensland and the Northern Territory. It operates 18 cattle stations and two feedlots with over 456,000 beef cattle.

australian-ethical-investment.name: Australian Ethical Investment
australian-ethical-investment.description: Australian Ethical is an ethical investment management company based in Sydney, Australia. It is publicly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX).

australian-pharmaceutical-industries.name: Australian Pharmaceutical Industries
australian-pharmaceutical-industries.description: Australian Pharmaceutical Industries (API) is an Australian health and beauty company owned by Wesfarmers. It is involved in pharmaceutical distribution, retailing, and manufacturing, operating retail brands such as Soul Pattinson and Pharmacist Advice.

autozone.name: AutoZone
autozone.description: AutoZone, Inc. is an American retailer specializing in aftermarket automotive parts and accessories. Founded in 1979, it is the largest retailer of its kind in the United States. The company is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, and operates stores across the US, Mexico, Puerto Rico, Brazil, and the US Virgin Islands.

autotrader-ltd.name: Autotrader Ltd
autotrader-ltd.description: Autotrader Group plc is a British online marketplace and classified advertising business focused on the automotive sector. It is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index. The company operates primarily in the United Kingdom.

avalonbay.name: AvalonBay
avalonbay.description: AvalonBay Communities, Inc. was a publicly traded real estate investment trust focused on apartment investments. In August 2026, it merged with Equity Residential to form Vivmark Residential. The company operated in the United States.

avanza.name: Avanza
avanza.description: Avanza Bank Holding AB is a Swedish online bank based in Stockholm specializing in savings, investments, and pensions. It is the largest stockbroker in Sweden and on the Stockholm Stock Exchange. The bank serves over two million customers and holds a significant share of the Swedish savings market.

aviat-networks.name: Aviat Networks
aviat-networks.description: Aviat Networks, Inc. is a global provider of microwave transport and backhaul solutions. It supplies communications infrastructure to both public and private telecommunications operators and enterprise customers. The company operates internationally.

avista.name: Avista
avista.description: Avista Corporation is an American energy company that generates and transmits electricity and distributes natural gas. It serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers across parts of Washington, Idaho, and Oregon. The company employs approximately 1,550 people and covers a service territory of 30,000 square miles.

avita-medical.name: Avita Medical
avita-medical.description: Avita Medical is an Australian clinical and commercial company developing regenerative medicine products. Its first product was ReCell spray-on skin for burn treatment. Other products include PermeaDerm and Cohealyx, which are used for wound coverage and treatment of severe wounds and burns.

avnet.name: Avnet
avnet.description: Avnet, Inc. is a distributor of electronic components headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. Founded in 1921 by Charles Avnet, the company was incorporated in 1955 and began trading on the New York Stock Exchange in 1961. It later moved its stock listing to Nasdaq in 2018.

avocet-mining.name: Avocet Mining
avocet-mining.description: Avocet Mining plc is a gold mining and exploration company focused on West Africa, with primary operations in Burkina Faso and Guinea. It is based in the United Kingdom and is listed on the London Stock Exchange and the Oslo Børs.

axcelis-technologies.name: Axcelis Technologies
axcelis-technologies.description: Axcelis Technologies, Inc. is an American company that designs, manufactures, and services capital equipment for the semiconductor industry worldwide. It produces ion implantation and curing systems used in semiconductor chip fabrication. The company is headquartered in Beverly, Massachusetts and was incorporated in 1995.

azurix.name: Azurix
azurix.description: Azurix Corp. is a water services company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It owned and operated facilities in North America, Europe, and South America. In 2007, it was awarded a $165 million claim against the government of Argentina and is involved in a dispute over payment.

alexandria-real-estate-equities.name: Alexandria Real Estate Equities
alexandria-real-estate-equities.description: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. is a real estate investment trust based in Pasadena, California. It invests in office buildings and laboratories leased to life science and technology tenants, often near universities. The company owns major campuses including the Alexandria Center for Life Science in Manhattan and properties in the Boston area.

aphria.name: Aphria
aphria.description: Aphria Inc., headquartered in Leamington, Ontario, Canada, was an international producer and distributor of medicinal and recreational cannabis. It operated through retail and wholesale channels in Canada and internationally.

automatic-data-processing.name: Automatic Data Processing
automatic-data-processing.description: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. (ADP) is an American multinational company headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey. It provides cloud-based human resources management, payroll processing, and professional employer organization services.

amorepacific-corporation.name: Amorepacific Corporation
amorepacific-corporation.description: Amorepacific Corporation is a South Korean beauty and cosmetics chaebol operating over 30 brands including Sulwhasoo and Laneige. Founded in 1945 by Sungwhan Suh, it is the largest cosmetics company in South Korea and among the top ten globally.

axos-financial.name: Axos Financial
axos-financial.description: Axos Financial, Inc. is an American bank holding company based in Las Vegas, Nevada. It is the parent company of Axos Bank, a direct bank listed among the largest banks in the United States. The company also offers registered investment adviser services and an electronic trading platform.

als-limited.name: ALS Limited
als-limited.description: ALS Limited is an Australian company headquartered in Brisbane that provides testing, inspection, certification, and verification services. It operates from over 370 sites across 65 countries. In 2012, ALS Limited was inducted into the Queensland Business Leaders Hall of Fame.

arkan-by-aswa-development-company.name: Arkan By Aswa Development Company
arkan-by-aswa-development-company.description: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate (DAAR) is a Saudi Arabian property development company based in Riyadh. Established in 1994, it is the largest developer by market value in Saudi Arabia and has close ties to the Saudi government.

astellas-pharma.name: Astellas Pharma
astellas-pharma.description: Astellas Pharma Inc. is a Japanese multinational pharmaceutical company formed on April 1, 2005, from the merger of Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry.

ascena-retail-group.name: Ascena Retail Group
ascena-retail-group.description: KnitWell Group, formerly known as Ascena Retail Group, Inc., is an American retailer of women's clothing. It owns brands including Ann Taylor, Loft, Lane Bryant, Justice, and Talbots. The company merged with Talbots and is a portfolio company of Sycamore Partners.

anhui-conch-cement-co-ltd.name: Anhui Conch Cement Co., Ltd.
anhui-conch-cement-co-ltd.industry: Cement industry in the People's Republic of China
anhui-conch-cement-co-ltd.description: Anhui Conch Cement Co., Ltd., also known as Anhui Conch, is the largest cement manufacturer and seller in mainland China. The company is headquartered in Anhui Province and focuses on the manufacture and sales of cement and clinker.

abrdn.name: Abrdn
abrdn.description: Aberdeen Group plc, trading as Aberdeen, is a wealth and investment company headquartered in Edinburgh, Scotland. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index. The company's registered office is on George Street in Edinburgh.

asmpt.name: ASMPT
asmpt.description: ASMPT, formerly ASM Pacific Technology, is a Singapore-headquartered company listed in Hong Kong. It designs and manufactures machines and tools used in semiconductor and electronics assembly industries and was originally the Asia division of ASM International.

axiall-corporation.name: Axiall Corporation
axiall-corporation.description: Axiall Corporation manufactures and markets chlorovinyls and aromatics. After acquiring Royal Group Technologies, it also produces building materials such as piping, siding, window profiles, decking, and fencing.

asmedia.name: ASMedia
asmedia.description: ASMedia Technology Inc. is a Taiwanese integrated circuit design company. It designs USB, PCI Express, and SATA controllers, including most AM4 chipsets for AMD's Zen micro-architecture.

afterpay.name: Afterpay
afterpay.description: Afterpay Limited is an Australian technology company specializing in buy now, pay later lending. Founded in 2014, it is now owned by Block, Inc. Afterpay is one of the three most-used BNPL services globally.

appian-corporation.name: Appian Corporation
appian-corporation.description: Appian Corporation is an enterprise software company headquartered in McLean, Virginia. It specializes in process automation and AI agent orchestrations, selling software to automate complex processes for large enterprises and governments worldwide.

avanos-medical.name: Avanos Medical
avanos-medical.description: Avanos Medical, Inc. is a medical technology company in the United States that produces clinical medical devices. It operates two franchises focused on pain management and chronic care, aiming to reduce opioid use and help patients recover faster while preventing infection.

ansell.name: Ansell
ansell.description: Ansell Limited is an Australian company manufacturing gloves and personal protection equipment primarily from latex and rubber. Its products are designed for healthcare professionals, industrial workers, and end consumers.

antarchile.name: AntarChile
antarchile.description: AntarChile is the main holding company of the Angelini Group, one of South America's largest conglomerates. It has major investments in industrial, forestry, fisheries, and energy sectors in Chile.

astrotech-corporation.name: Astrotech Corporation
astrotech-corporation.description: Astrotech Corporation, formerly Spacehab Inc., is a technology incubator headquartered in Austin, Texas. It funds, manages, and sells start-up companies using technology sourced internally and from research institutions. Its subsidiaries provide commercial products and services to NASA, the U.S. Department of Defense, and other space agencies.

avangrid.name: Avangrid
avangrid.description: Avangrid, Inc. is an energy services and delivery company serving about 3.1 million customers in New England and New York. Its subsidiaries include Central Maine Power, Rochester Gas and Electric, and New York State Electric & Gas.

arlo-technologies-inc.name: Arlo Technologies, Inc.
arlo-technologies-inc.description: Arlo Technologies is an American company that manufactures wireless surveillance cameras. It was formerly a brand of Netgear before its IPO on the New York Stock Exchange in August 2018.

appen.name: Appen
appen.description: Appen Limited is an Australian multinational company that develops datasets for artificial intelligence. It is publicly traded on the Australian Securities Exchange under the code APX.

advanced-drainage-systems.name: Advanced Drainage Systems
advanced-drainage-systems.description: Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets plastic pipes, septic tanks, and drainage systems. Headquartered in Hilliard, Ohio, it is the largest maker of high-density polyethylene pipe in the United States. Most of its sales are within the US and Canada.

audax.name: Audax
audax.description: Audax Renovables, S.A., trading as Audax, is a Spanish electricity and natural gas company headquartered in Badalona, Catalonia. It supplies electricity and gas to customers in several European countries and generates electricity from renewable sources like wind and solar. It was formerly known as Fersa Energías Renovables.

apollo-global-management.name: Apollo Global Management
apollo-global-management.description: Apollo Global Management, Inc. is an American asset management firm investing primarily in alternative assets. It manages assets on behalf of pension funds, endowments, sovereign wealth funds, and other investors. Its investments include credit, private equity, and real assets like real estate and infrastructure.

aramark.name: Aramark
aramark.description: Aramark is an American food service and facilities services provider operating in North America and 14 other countries including the UK, Germany, and Spain. It serves clients in education, prisons, healthcare, business, and leisure sectors.

autodesk.name: Autodesk
autodesk.description: Autodesk, Inc. is an American multinational software corporation headquartered in San Francisco, California. It provides software products and services for industries including architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing, media, education, and entertainment. Autodesk has offices across the United States and Canada.

arctic-cat.name: Arctic Cat
arctic-cat.description: Arctic Cat is an American brand that manufactures snowmobiles and all-terrain vehicles in Thief River Falls, Minnesota. Founded in 1960, the company designs, engineers, manufactures, and markets these vehicles.

aptiv.name: Aptiv
aptiv.description: Aptiv PLC is a supplier of automotive technology and components. It is organized in Jersey and has tax residency in Schaffhausen, Switzerland. The company operates 139 manufacturing facilities and 11 technical centers across 50 countries.

acc-limited.name: ACC Limited
acc-limited.description: ACC Limited is an Indian cement producer headquartered in Mumbai. It is a subsidiary of Ambuja Cements and part of the Adani Group. The company was established in 1936 and renamed ACC Limited in 2006.

affirm.name: Affirm
affirm.description: Affirm Holdings, Inc. is an American financial technology company and point-of-sale lender founded in 2012 by PayPal co-founder Max Levchin. It is the largest U.S.-based buy now, pay later financier. The company operates in the fintech industry.

automatic-bank-services.name: Automatic Bank Services
automatic-bank-services.description: Automatic Bank Services Ltd. is an Israeli company providing communications and computing services in the banking sector, specializing in clearing credit card transactions. Its offices are currently located in the Azrieli Holon center.

a1-telekom-austria-group.name: A1 Telekom Austria Group
a1-telekom-austria-group.description: A1 Telekom Austria Group is a telecommunications provider headquartered in Vienna. It offers fixed-line, broadband Internet, multimedia, data, IT systems, and mobile payment services across seven European countries and is a subsidiary of América Móvil.

armstrong-world-industries.name: Armstrong World Industries
armstrong-world-industries.description: Armstrong World Industries, Inc. is an international designer and manufacturer of wall and ceiling building materials headquartered in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. As of 2014, it had 3,100 employees and a global manufacturing network of 17 facilities.

axon-enterprise.name: Axon Enterprise
axon-enterprise.description: Axon Enterprise, Inc. is an American company based in Scottsdale, Arizona. It develops weapons and technology products for military, law enforcement, and civilian markets.

amuse.name: Amuse
amuse.description: Amuse Inc. is a Japanese entertainment company that provides artist management services. Its roster includes idols, musicians, and other entertainers.

asahi-breweries.name: Asahi Breweries
asahi-breweries.description: Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd. is a Japanese beverage holding company headquartered in Tokyo. It is the largest beer brewer in Japan and holds significant market shares in Australia and several European countries.

agc.name: AGC
agc.description: AGC Inc., formerly Asahi Glass Co., Ltd., is a Japanese global glass manufacturing company headquartered in Tokyo. It is the largest glass company worldwide and part of the Mitsubishi group.

avient-corporation.name: Avient Corporation
avient-corporation.description: Avient Corporation is a global materials solutions company headquartered in Avon Lake, Ohio, United States. It produces colorants, advanced composites, functional additives, and engineered materials.

ashland-inc.name: Ashland Inc.
ashland-inc.description: Ashland, Inc. is an American chemical company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware. Founded in 1924 as an oil refinery in Ashland, Kentucky, it moved to Wilmington in 1994. The company has five divisions including Chemical Intermediates and Solvents, and was the primary manufacturer of Valvoline until 2017.

australian-securities-exchange.name: Australian Securities Exchange
australian-securities-exchange.description: Australian Securities Exchange Ltd (ASX) operates Australia's primary securities exchange. It was formed in 1987 by merging six state securities exchanges and later merged with the Sydney Futures Exchange in 2006.

alteryx.name: Alteryx
alteryx.description: Alteryx, Inc. is an American computer software company founded in 1997 and based in Irvine, California. It develops products using data science and analytics and was acquired by private equity companies in December 2023.

ausnet-services.name: AusNet Services
ausnet-services.description: AusNet is an Australian energy delivery services company owning and operating electricity and gas network assets. It was formerly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange and Singapore Exchange and is now a subsidiary of Brookfield Asset Management.

atari-sa.name: Atari SA
atari-sa.description: Atari SA is a Luxembourgish holding company that owns video gaming-related interactive entertainment properties. It publishes games under labels including Atari, Inc., Nightdive Studios, and Digital Eclipse. The company also produces video game consoles such as the Atari VCS and owns intellectual property rights to many classic video game properties.

atlantic-petroleum.name: Atlantic Petroleum
atlantic-petroleum.description: Atlantic Petroleum P/F is an oil and gas company based in Tórshavn, Faroe Islands, with technical offices in London and Bergen. It participates in exploration and production activities on the Faroese Continental Shelf and in the North Sea, including development projects.

autonation.name: AutoNation
autonation.description: AutoNation, Inc. is an American automotive retailer based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Founded in 1996 by Wayne Huizenga, it provides new and pre-owned vehicles and related services across the United States with over 300 retail outlets.

autogrill.name: Autogrill
autogrill.description: Autogrill S.p.A. is an Italian multinational catering company controlled by the Benetton family's Edizione Holding. It operates primarily in airport terminals and motorway service areas, which account for over 90% of its business.

autoliv.name: Autoliv
autoliv.description: Autoliv AB is a Swedish automotive safety supplier founded in 1953 and headquartered in Stockholm. It is the world’s largest supplier of automotive safety systems, producing airbags, seatbelts, and steering wheels for car manufacturers.

avex-group.name: Avex Group
avex-group.description: Avex Inc. is a Japanese entertainment conglomerate headquartered in Tokyo, founded in 1988. It manages J-pop talents and has expanded into anime, video games, and live music events. The company is part of the Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group keiretsu.

axfood.name: Axfood
axfood.description: Axfood AB is a Swedish retail company created in May 2000 by merging several grocery store chains including Hemköp and Spar Sverige. It operates primarily in Sweden's grocery retail market.

avic-aircraft-corporation-ltd.name: AVIC Aircraft Corporation Ltd.
avic-aircraft-corporation-ltd.description: AVIC Xi'an Aircraft Industry Group Company Ltd. is a publicly listed state-owned enterprise based in Xi'an, Shaanxi, China. It manufactures and markets structural parts and components for aircraft and automobiles. The company was founded and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 1997.

atento.name: Atento
atento.description: Atento is a global provider of customer relationship management and business-process outsourcing services, including customer care, sales, collections, back office, and technical support. It was the largest provider in Latin America and among the top five globally by revenue in 2015.

alaska-airlines.name: Alaska Airlines
alaska-airlines.description: Alaska Airlines is a major U.S. airline headquartered in SeaTac, Washington. It operates a route network focused on connecting West Coast cities to over 100 destinations across the U.S., North America, Asia, Oceania, and Europe, partnering with Horizon Air and SkyWest Airlines.

ankai.name: Ankai
ankai.description: Anhui Ankai Automobile Co., Ltd. is a Chinese automotive manufacturer headquartered in Hefei, Anhui. It specializes in producing buses and coaches, including urban buses and sleeping berth coaches, and offers repair and maintenance services worldwide.

adani-energy-solutions.name: Adani Energy Solutions
adani-energy-solutions.description: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd is an Indian electric power transmission and distribution company headquartered in Ahmedabad. It operates a transmission network of 26,696 circuit kilometers and is among the largest private sector power transmission companies in India.

adani-green-energy.name: Adani Green Energy
adani-green-energy.description: Adani Green Energy Limited is an Indian renewable energy company headquartered in Ahmedabad. Majority-owned by Adani Group and minority-owned by TotalEnergies, it operates the Kamuthi Solar Power Project, one of the largest solar photovoltaic plants worldwide.

aveva.name: AVEVA
aveva.description: AVEVA Group plc is a British multinational information technology consulting company headquartered in Cambridge, England. It originated as the Computer-Aided Design Centre created in 1967 by the UK Ministry of Technology and Cambridge University.

aboitizpower.name: AboitizPower
aboitizpower.description: Aboitiz Power Corporation, also known as AboitizPower, is a Philippine holding company engaged in power distribution, generation, and retail electricity services. It is a subsidiary of Aboitiz Equity Ventures (AEV).

all-in-games.name: All in! Games
all-in-games.description: All in! Games SA is a video game publisher based in Kraków, Poland. The company publishes games on all main gaming platforms and works on international projects.

adama-agricultural-solutions-ltd.name: Adama Agricultural Solutions Ltd.
adama-agricultural-solutions-ltd.description: ADAMA Ltd. is a global crop-protection company based in Israel that develops and distributes herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides. It operates internationally with a direct presence in 20 agricultural markets.

allergan-plc.name: Allergan plc
allergan-plc.description: Allergan plc is an American, Irish-domiciled pharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, and markets brand name drugs and medical devices. It operates in areas such as medical aesthetics, eye care, central nervous system, and gastroenterology, and is known as the maker of Botox.

alior-bank.name: Alior Bank
alior-bank.description: Alior Bank SA is a universal bank in Poland founded in 2008 and a subsidiary of insurance company PZU SA since 2015. It is among the top ten banking groups in Poland and is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

alfa-group.name: ALFA Group
alfa-group.description: Alfa S.A.B. de C.V., known as Alfa, is a Mexican company headquartered in Monterrey. It transitioned from a multinational conglomerate to a pure play consumer packaged goods business.

arconic.name: Arconic
arconic.description: Arconic Corporation is an American industrial company specializing in lightweight metals engineering and manufacturing. Its products serve industries including aerospace, automotive, packaging, oil and gas, and defense worldwide.

atkinsrealis.name: AtkinsRéalis
atkinsrealis.description: AtkinsRéalis Group Inc., formerly SNC-Lavalin Group Inc., is a Canadian company based in Montreal providing engineering, procurement, and construction services across various industries including mining, environment, infrastructure, and clean energy.

amplify-energy.name: Amplify Energy
amplify-energy.description: Amplify Energy Corp is a crude oil company based in Houston, Texas, USA. Founded in 2017, it operates in the oil and gas industry and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

arcturus-therapeutics.name: Arcturus Therapeutics
arcturus-therapeutics.description: Arcturus Therapeutics Holdings Inc. is an American biotechnology company specializing in RNA medicines. It focuses on developing therapeutics for rare and infectious diseases using proprietary lipid nanoparticle RNA technologies.

azul-linhas-aereas-brasileiras.name: Azul Linhas Aéreas Brasileiras
azul-linhas-aereas-brasileiras.description: Azul Linhas Aéreas Brasileiras is a Brazilian airline headquartered in Barueri, São Paulo. Established in 2008 by David Neeleman, it focuses on providing frequent and affordable air service to underserved markets in Brazil. The airline began operations in December 2008.

arcelormittal-kryvyi-rih.name: ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih
arcelormittal-kryvyi-rih.description: ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih is a Ukrainian steelworks located in Kryvyi Rih, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast. Founded in 1931 as Krivorozhstal, it was destroyed during World War II and later reconstructed and expanded. It was named after Vladimir I. Lenin following its reconstruction.

access-bank.name: Access Bank
access-bank.description: Access Bank Plc is a Nigerian multinational commercial bank owned by Access Bank Group. It is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria, the national banking regulator.

arkema.name: Arkema
arkema.description: Arkema S.A. is a French multinational manufacturer of specialty materials headquartered in La Défense near Paris. The company operates in three specialty materials segments: adhesives, advanced materials, and coatings, along with a segment covering primary materials.

agrale.name: Agrale
agrale.description: Agrale is a Brazilian vehicle manufacturer producing tractors, commercial vehicles, military vehicles, bus chassis, and engines. It manufactures both self-developed tractor models and those based on Zetor designs. The company was previously known as Agrisa.

air-algerie.name: Air Algérie
air-algerie.description: Air Algérie SpA is the flag carrier airline of Algeria, headquartered in Algiers. It operates scheduled flights to 33 domestic and 42 international destinations across multiple continents. The airline is fully owned by the Government of Algeria.

acerinox.name: Acerinox
acerinox.description: Acerinox, S.A. is a steel manufacturer headquartered in Madrid, Spain. It is the fourth largest stainless steel producer worldwide and operates factories across Europe, Asia, the U.S., and South Africa, focusing on increasing production in the U.S.

aje-group.name: AJE Group
aje-group.description: Ajegroup, or AJE, is a Peruvian multinational company that manufactures, distributes, and sells alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Founded in 1988 in Ayacucho, Peru, it is known for its flagship product Kola Real. The company operates in the beverage industry.

administracion-nacional-de-usinas-y-tras.name: Administración Nacional de Usinas y Trasmisiones Eléctricas
administracion-nacional-de-usinas-y-tras.legal_name: Administración Nacional de Usinas y Trasmisiones Eléctricas
administracion-nacional-de-usinas-y-tras.industry: Electric power generation, transmission and distribution
administracion-nacional-de-usinas-y-tras.description: The National Administration of Power Plants and Electrical Transmissions, known as UTE, is Uruguay's government-owned power company. Established in 1912, it operates as a monopoly in electric power generation, transmission, and distribution. UTE was created following the approval of Law 4273.

antel.name: ANTEL
antel.description: Administración Nacional de Telecomunicaciones (ANTEL) is Uruguay's government-owned telecommunications company founded in 1974. It was spun off from UTE's telecommunications division and holds a monopoly on landline telephony and data services. ANTEL also provides mobile phone and Internet-related services in Uruguay.

arjo.name: Arjo
arjo.description: Arjo is a global medical technology company serving acute and long-term care needs. It produces medical equipment for patient handling, hygiene, medical beds, pressure ulcer prevention, wound healing, and diagnostics. The company operates in the healthcare sector.

altafiber.name: Altafiber
altafiber.description: Cincinnati Bell, Inc., doing business as Altafiber, is a regional telecommunications service provider based in Cincinnati, Ohio. It provides landline telephone, fiber-optic Internet, and IPTV services through subsidiaries including Hawaiian Telcom. The company operates in the telecommunications sector.

alexbank.name: Alexbank
alexbank.description: Alexbank, formerly Bank of Alexandria, is a medium-sized Egyptian bank founded in 1957. Intesa Sanpaolo is the major shareholder. The bank operates in Egypt's financial sector.

alpargatas-argentina.name: Alpargatas Argentina
alpargatas-argentina.description: Alpargatas S.A.I.C. is an Argentine manufacturing company specializing in clothing and footwear. Established in 1885, it was the leading textile and footwear manufacturer in Argentina and became a subsidiary of Brazilian Alpargatas S.A. in 2007.

audi-brasil.name: Audi Brasil
audi-brasil.description: Audi Brasil Distribuidora de Veículos is a Brazilian company that imports and distributes Audi cars in Brazil. It was established in 2000 as a joint venture named Audi Senna.

amica-s-a.name: Amica S.A.
amica-s-a.description: Amica is a global manufacturer of household appliances headquartered in Wronki, Poland. It produces refrigerators, washing machines, dishwashers, vacuum cleaners, microwave ovens, electric stoves, and kettles under brands such as Hansa, CDA, and Gram.

amylin-pharmaceuticals.name: Amylin Pharmaceuticals
amylin-pharmaceuticals.description: Amylin Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was a biopharmaceutical company founded in 1987 and based in San Diego, California. It focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing drug candidates for diabetes, obesity, and other diseases. The company produced three drugs: Symlin, Byetta, and Bydureon.

acciona-energia.name: Acciona Energía
acciona-energia.description: Acciona Energía is a subsidiary of Acciona based in Madrid, Spain. It operates in the energy industry focusing on clean energy through project development, engineering, construction, operations, and asset management. The company is involved in multiple stages of clean energy projects.

arep.name: AREP
arep.description: AREP is a multidisciplinary consultancy wholly owned by SNCF, founded in 1997 by architects and engineers. It employs 600 staff from about 15 countries and focuses on ecological design through the EMC2B approach.

air-seychelles.name: Air Seychelles
air-seychelles.description: Air Seychelles is the national airline of the Republic of Seychelles. Its head office is located at Seychelles International Airport on the island of Mahé. The airline operates inter-island, international, and charter flights.

art-technology-group.name: Art Technology Group
art-technology-group.description: Art Technology Group (ATG) was an American internet technology company specializing in eCommerce software and on-demand optimization applications. It was independent until its acquisition by Oracle on January 5, 2011. The company operated in the technology sector.

airkenya-express.name: Airkenya Express
airkenya-express.description: Airkenya Express is an airline based in Nairobi, Kenya. It operates domestic scheduled and charter flights, as well as scheduled services to Tanzania. Its main base is Wilson Airport in Nairobi.

algerian-red-crescent.name: Algerian Red Crescent
algerian-red-crescent.description: The Algerian Red Crescent is a humanitarian volunteer organization in Algeria founded in 1957. It has been recognized by the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement since 1963. The organization focuses on emergency and relief activities.

ace-team.name: ACE Team
ace-team.description: ACE Team Software S.A. is a Chilean video game developer based in Santiago. Founded in the late 1990s by the Bordeu brothers, the company initially developed total conversions before moving to commercial game development. Operations were paused between 2003 and 2007 while two founders worked at Wanako Games.

avolta.name: Avolta
avolta.description: Avolta AG is a Swiss travel retailer headquartered in Basel. It operates duty-free and duty-paid shops and convenience stores in airports, cruise lines, seaports, railway stations, and tourist areas across over 75 countries.

austral-gold.name: Austral Gold
austral-gold.description: Austral Gold is a mining company headquartered in Sydney, Australia. It focuses on the exploration, development, and production of gold and silver with assets located in South America and the United States. The company is dual-listed on the Australian Securities Exchange and the TSX Venture Exchange.

alvarion.name: Alvarion
alvarion.description: Alvarion Technologies Ltd. is an Israeli company providing autonomous Wi-Fi networks with self-organizing capabilities. Their solutions serve carrier-grade Wi-Fi, enterprise connectivity, smart city planning, hospitality, campuses, and events. The company focuses on advanced wireless network technologies.

alderon-iron-ore-corp.name: Alderon Iron Ore Corp.
alderon-iron-ore-corp.description: Alderon Iron Ore Corp. was a Canadian development-stage company focused on exploration, development, and mining of an iron ore property in the Labrador Trough near the Quebec border. It owned 75% of the Kami Project, a high-grade iron ore project, and had a strategic partnership with HBIS Group of China.

allied-irish-banks.name: Allied Irish Banks
allied-irish-banks.description: Allied Irish Banks, p.l.c. is one of the Big Four commercial banks in the Republic of Ireland. It offers a full range of personal, business, and corporate banking services, as well as general insurance products and life assurance and pensions through AIB Life.

atlas-mara-limited.name: Atlas Mara Limited
atlas-mara-limited.description: Atlas Mara Limited is a financial services holding company formed to acquire target banks in Africa. It was formerly known as Atlas Mara Co-Nvest Limited and is based in the United Arab Emirates.

altice-portugal.name: Altice Portugal
altice-portugal.description: MEO Portugal S.A. is the largest telecommunications service provider in Portugal. Since 2015, it has been a wholly owned subsidiary of Altice, a multinational telecommunications company with presence in multiple countries.

alfamart.name: Alfamart
alfamart.description: PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk, known as Alfamart, is an Indonesian primarily-franchised convenience store chain. Founded in 1989 in Jakarta, it has expanded to over 18,000 stores across Indonesia and the Philippines, serving millions of daily customers.

actel.name: Actel
actel.description: Actel Corporation was an American manufacturer of nonvolatile, low-power field-programmable gate arrays and programmable logic solutions. It was headquartered in Mountain View, California, with offices worldwide. In 2010, Actel was acquired by Microsemi, which was later acquired by Microchip Technology.

allen-bradley.name: Allen-Bradley
allen-bradley.description: Allen-Bradley is a brand of factory automation equipment owned by Rockwell Automation, headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The company manufactures programmable logic controllers, human-machine interfaces, sensors, safety components, software, drives, and motor control systems. Rockwell Automation also provides asset-management services.

azure-power.name: Azure Power
azure-power.description: Azure Power Global Limited is an Indian solar power company headquartered in New Delhi. Founded in 2008 by Inderpreet Wadhwa, it sells energy to government utilities and independent industrial and commercial customers in India.

a-w.name: A&W
a-w.description: A&W is a fast-food restaurant chain in Canada, franchised by A&W Food Services of Canada Inc. It operates within the Canadian fast-food industry.

atm-grupa.name: ATM Grupa
atm-grupa.description: ATM Grupa S.A. is the largest independent TV producer in Poland, founded in 1992. It holds about 14 percent of the Polish market and uniquely owns its own technical and logistic base for TV program production.

aruba-networks.name: Aruba Networks
aruba-networks.description: HPE Aruba Networking, formerly Aruba Networks, is a security and networking subsidiary of Hewlett Packard Enterprise based in Santa Clara, California. The company operates in the computer networking sector. It provides networking solutions as part of HPE.

amec-foster-wheeler.name: Amec Foster Wheeler
amec-foster-wheeler.description: Amec Foster Wheeler was a British multinational consultancy, engineering, and project management company headquartered in London, England.

arc-resources.name: ARC Resources
arc-resources.description: ARC Resources Ltd. is a Canadian energy company operating primarily in the Montney resource play in Alberta and northeast British Columbia. The company has been in operation since 1996.

aastra-technologies.name: Aastra Technologies
aastra-technologies.description: Aastra Technologies Limited was a Canadian company based in Concord, Ontario, producing communication network products including telephone terminals, PBX systems, and digital video equipment. Its residential phones were sold in the US under the Bell equipment brand by Sonecor.

astarta-holding.name: Astarta Holding
astarta-holding.description: ASTARTA Holding is a vertically integrated agro-industrial company based in Ukraine. It produces food products with a focus on global markets. The company is publicly traded as a European company.

aerojet-rocketdyne-holdings.name: Aerojet Rocketdyne Holdings
aerojet-rocketdyne-holdings.description: Aerojet Rocketdyne was a company that manufactured rocket, hypersonic, and electric propulsive systems for space, defense, civil, and commercial applications. It was formed in 2013 by merging Aerojet and Pratt & Whitney Rocketdyne and was acquired by L3Harris in 2023.

agora-sa.name: Agora SA
agora-sa.description: Agora Spółka Akcyjna is a Polish media company known for creating Gazeta Wyborcza, the first independent newspaper in Poland. Founded around 1989, Agora has grown into one of the largest media companies in Poland and is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

alterra-power.name: Alterra Power
alterra-power.description: Alterra Power Corp., based in Vancouver, Canada, was a diversified renewable power generation company. Formed in 2011 through a merger, it developed and operated hydroelectric, wind, solar, and geothermal projects before being acquired by Innergex Renewable Energy Inc. in 2018.

alco-stores.name: ALCO Stores
alco-stores.description: ALCO Stores, Inc. was a retail chain operating 198 stores in 23 states primarily in the U.S. Midwest. The company was founded in 1901 in Kansas by Alva Lease Duckwall.

atco.name: ATCO
atco.description: ATCO Ltd., operating as the ATCO Group, is a publicly-traded Canadian engineering, logistics, and energy holding company based in Calgary, Alberta. Its subsidiaries include electric utilities, natural gas production and distribution companies, and construction companies. ATCO is involved in electricity generation among other sectors.

atp-oil-and-gas.name: ATP Oil and Gas
atp-oil-and-gas.description: ATP Oil & Gas Corporation was a Houston, Texas-based company that developed and produced oil and natural gas in the Gulf of Mexico and the North Sea. The company specialized in developing reserves in these regions.

ats-automation-tooling-systems.name: ATS Automation Tooling Systems
ats-automation-tooling-systems.description: ATS Corporation is a Canadian company based in Cambridge, Ontario, that designs and builds factory automation systems. It is publicly listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and operates in the industrial automation sector.

ats-medical.name: ATS Medical
ats-medical.description: ATS Medical, Inc. was a developer and manufacturer of products for the cardiac surgery market based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The company was acquired by Medtronic in 2010.

avx-corporation.name: AVX Corporation
avx-corporation.description: AVX Corporation is an American manufacturer of electronic components headquartered in Fountain Inn, South Carolina. It is the largest industrial employer in Horry County, South Carolina, and operates in the United States, Europe, and Asia. AVX is a subsidiary of Kyocera Electronics Corporation.

aabsal.name: Aabsal
aabsal.description: Aabsal is a major manufacturer of home appliances in Iran, established in 1956 and listed on the Tehran Stock Exchange. The company produces air coolers, gas heaters, gas cookers, washing machines, and other household products.

abcam.name: Abcam
abcam.description: Abcam Limited is a producer, distributor, and seller of protein research tools operating worldwide from 13 locations with 1,800 employees, including 400 in Research and Development. It was listed on the Nasdaq and London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Danaher Corporation in 2023.

accuride-corporation.name: Accuride Corporation
accuride-corporation.description: Accuride Corporation is a diversified manufacturer and supplier of commercial vehicle components in North America. The company is based in Livonia, Michigan, and designs, manufactures, and markets these components.

acquity-group.name: Acquity Group
acquity-group.description: Acquity Group, LLC was an eCommerce and digital marketing company headquartered in Chicago with offices across North America. It was acquired by Accenture in 2013.

alarmforce.name: AlarmForce
alarmforce.description: AlarmForce Industries Inc. is a Toronto-based company that manufactures and provides home security and home automation systems. It operates in both residential and commercial security segments. The company is based in Canada.

aldila.name: Aldila
aldila.description: Aldila, Inc. is a sports equipment manufacturer based in Carlsbad, California. It specializes in OEM and consumer golf club shafts and also produces other carbon fiber products. The company operates in the consumer goods and retail industry.

amrest.name: AmRest
amrest.description: AmRest Holdings SE is a European multinational operator of casual dining, fast-food restaurants, and coffee shops headquartered in Madrid, Spain. It operates over 2300 locations, mostly franchises of KFC, Pizza Hut, and Starbucks, across multiple countries including Spain, China, and several European nations.

amlin.name: Amlin
amlin.description: MS Amlin Ltd is an insurer operating in the Lloyd's, UK, Continental Europe, and Bermudian markets. It specializes in insurance cover for commercial enterprises and reinsurance protection for other insurance companies. The company was acquired by Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Group in 2016.

anaren.name: Anaren
anaren.description: Anaren, Inc. was an American manufacturer of high-frequency radio and microwave electronics based in Syracuse, New York. Founded in 1967, it produced RF microelectronics and components for aerospace, defense, networking, and communications industries before being acquired by TTM Technologies in 2018.

ann-taylor.name: Ann Taylor
ann-taylor.description: Ann Inc. is an American specialty apparel retail group headquartered in New York City. It operates as a subsidiary of Ascena Retail Group and markets its brand under five divisions including Ann Taylor and Loft, offering classic-styled suits, separates, dresses, shoes, and accessories.

annie-s-homegrown.name: Annie's Homegrown
annie-s-homegrown.description: Annie's Homegrown is an American organic food company owned by General Mills. Founded in Hampton, Connecticut, it is best known for its macaroni and cheese product line, which is the second-best selling in the United States. The company also produces Annie's Naturals condiments and sauces.

anworth-mortgage-asset-corporation.name: Anworth Mortgage Asset Corporation
anworth-mortgage-asset-corporation.description: Anworth Mortgage Asset Corporation was a mortgage real estate investment trust. It was acquired by Ready Capital Corporation in 2021.

aryogen.name: AryoGen
aryogen.description: AryoGen Pharmed is an Iranian biopharmaceutical company specializing in manufacturing therapeutic monoclonal antibodies and other recombinant proteins. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry in Iran.

astoria-bank.name: Astoria Bank
astoria-bank.description: Astoria Financial Corporation was a bank holding company based in Lake Success, New York. It was acquired by Sterling Bancorp on October 2, 2017. The company operated in the financial services industry before its acquisition.

athabasca-oil-corporation.name: Athabasca Oil Corporation
athabasca-oil-corporation.description: Athabasca Oil Corporation is a Canadian petroleum company based in Calgary, Alberta. It focuses on developing thermal and light oil assets in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin and holds a significant land base of high-quality resources.

america-latina-logistica.name: América Latina Logística
america-latina-logistica.description: Rumo, formerly América Latina Logística (ALL), is a Brazilian logistics company focused on railway logistics. It is the largest company in Latin America in this segment and also provides transportation, port operations, and storage services.

autocanada.name: AutoCanada
autocanada.description: AutoCanada Inc. is a North American automobile dealership group operating 81 franchised dealerships across Canada and Illinois, USA. It sells vehicles from 27 brands and operates used vehicle dealerships, auctions, and collision centres.

avalon-rare-metals.name: Avalon Rare Metals
avalon-rare-metals.description: Avalon Advanced Materials Inc. is a Canadian mineral development company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It focuses primarily on rare metals and minerals, with principal assets including the Nechalacho Project and others in Nova Scotia and Ontario.

azarab-industries-company.name: Azarab Industries Company
azarab-industries-company.description: AzarAb Industries is an Iranian manufacturing corporation located in Arak. It constructs power plants, factories, petrochemical plants, and refineries for sugar, oil, and gas. As of 2005, it employed more than 2,500 people.

ao-world.name: AO World
ao-world.description: AO World plc, trading as ao.com, is an electrical retailer based in Bolton, England. It operates in the UK and formerly in Germany and the Netherlands, specializing in household kitchen appliances and electricals.

ayandeh-bank.name: Ayandeh Bank
ayandeh-bank.description: Ayandeh Bank was an Iranian bank established in 2013 by Ali Ansari. Its operating license was revoked in October 2025, and its operations were merged with Bank Melli Iran by the Central Bank of Iran.

amigo-loans.name: Amigo Loans
amigo-loans.description: Amigo Holdings is a British public company formerly known as Amigo Loans, a guarantor loans provider. In 2018, it held approximately 88% of the UK guarantor loan market.

aerospatiale.name: Aérospatiale
aerospatiale.description: Aérospatiale was a French state-owned aerospace and defence corporation founded in 1970. It was created through the merger of three state-owned aerospace firms: Nord Aviation, SEREB, and Sud Aviation. The company was based in France and operated in the arms industry.

astral-media.name: Astral Media
astral-media.description: Astral Media Inc. was a Canadian media conglomerate and the country's largest radio broadcaster with 84 stations across eight provinces. It also operated 23 specialty television channels, two conventional stations, and had a presence in out-of-home advertising. The company was a major player in premium and specialty television in Canada.

atlas-air.name: Atlas Air
atlas-air.description: Atlas Air, Inc. is a major American cargo and passenger charter airline based in White Plains, New York. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings and is the world's largest operator of the Boeing 747 aircraft. The airline operates globally to more than 300 destinations in 70 countries.

air-service-gabon.name: Air Service Gabon
air-service-gabon.description: Air Service Gabon was an airline based in Libreville, Gabon, established in 1965. It operated scheduled, passenger, and charter flights in West Africa. The airline ceased operations on August 3, 2010.

afric-aviation.name: Afric Aviation
afric-aviation.description: Afric Aviation is a regional airline headquartered in Port Gentil, Gabon. Its primary hub is Port-Gentil International Airport. The airline operates within the region.

air-excellence.name: Air Excellence
air-excellence.description: Air Excellence was an airline based in Libreville, Gabon. It was established in 2002 and ceased operations in 2004.

afrijet.name: AfriJet
afrijet.description: Afrijet Business Service is a Gabonese airline operating scheduled services to airports in Cameroon, Gabon, São Tomé, and the Republic of the Congo. It provides regional air transport services.

air-charter-africa.name: Air Charter Africa
air-charter-africa.description: Air Charter Africa was a charter airline based in Banjul, Gambia. It was established as Air Charter Express in 2007 and shortly renamed.

air-cote-d-ivoire.name: Air Côte d'Ivoire
air-cote-d-ivoire.description: Air Côte d'Ivoire is the flag carrier airline of Ivory Coast, based in Abidjan. It succeeded the former flag carrier Air Ivoire and started operations on November 12, 2012.

afriland-first-bank.name: Afriland First Bank
afriland-first-bank.description: Afriland First Group is a conglomerate with banks, insurance, and investment advisory businesses headquartered in Switzerland. Its flagship company, Afriland First Bank, is based in Yaoundé, Cameroon and was founded in 1987.

axis-lines-international.name: Axis Lines International
axis-lines-international.description: Axis Lines International was a planned start-up airline based in Douala, Cameroon. It intended to operate regional flights with McDonnell Douglas MD-80 aircraft and international flights to Brussels, Madrid, and Paris with a Boeing 767-300ER.

air-leasing-cameroon.name: Air Leasing Cameroon
air-leasing-cameroon.description: Air Leasing Cameroon is an air charter company based in Douala, Cameroon. It provides charter flight services within the region.

arabian-gulf-oil-company.name: Arabian Gulf Oil Company
arabian-gulf-oil-company.description: The Arabian Gulf Oil Company is an oil company based in Benghazi, Libya. It engages in crude oil and natural gas exploration, production, and refining. It operates as a subsidiary of the state-owned National Oil Corporation.

afriqiyah-airways.name: Afriqiyah Airways
afriqiyah-airways.description: Afriqiyah Airways is a Libyan state-owned airline based in Tripoli, established in 2001. It operates domestic and international flights with its main hub at Tripoli International Airport, serving destinations across Africa, the Middle East, and Europe.

air-libya.name: Air Libya
air-libya.description: Air Libya is a privately owned charter airline based in Benghazi, Libya. Established in 1996 as Tibesti Air Libya, it operates charter flights supporting oil field operations and some scheduled and ad hoc charter services. Its main base is Benina International Airport in Benghazi.

air-one-nine-company.name: Air One Nine Company
air-one-nine-company.description: Air One Nine Company was a charter airline based in Tripoli, Libya. The airline operated in the Libyan aviation sector but no further details are provided.

air-madagascar.name: Air Madagascar
air-madagascar.description: Madagascar Airlines is the flag carrier airline of Madagascar, based in Antananarivo. It operates international flights to Europe, Asia, and neighboring African and Indian Ocean islands, as well as an extensive domestic network from its main base at Ivato International Airport.

air-mauritius.name: Air Mauritius
