air-mauritius.description: Air Mauritius is the flag carrier airline of Mauritius, headquartered in Port Louis. It operates primarily from its hub at Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport. The airline represents the country as its national carrier.

al-mada.name: Al Mada
al-mada.description: Al Mada, formerly Société Nationale d'Investissement, is a private Moroccan holding company established in 1966. It is headquartered in Casablanca and mainly owned by the Moroccan royal family.

akwa-group.name: Akwa Group
akwa-group.description: Akwa Group is a private Moroccan conglomerate owned by the Akhannouch and Wakrim families. It operates in several key sectors including hydrocarbons, distribution, tourism, media, real estate, and renewable energy. The group is named after its founding families.

afriquia.name: Afriquia
afriquia.description: Afriquia is a Moroccan company engaged in the distribution of petroleum products. Founded in 1959, it is a subsidiary of the Akwa Group, a diversified Moroccan conglomerate.

atlas-corporation-studios.name: Atlas Corporation Studios
atlas-corporation-studios.description: Atlas Studios is a film studio located near Ouarzazate, Morocco. Many movie sets remain on the property, which lies in the desert and mountains, and the studio operates guided tours, making it a popular tourist destination.

aicha.name: Aïcha
aicha.description: Aïcha is a Moroccan food brand known for jams, tomato sauces, oils, olives, canned tuna, and harissa. Founded in 1929 in Meknes by French entrepreneurs, it became iconic in Moroccan households with its mascot, the little girl "Aïcha."

air-arabia-maroc.name: Air Arabia Maroc
air-arabia-maroc.description: Air Arabia Maroc is a Moroccan low-cost airline headquartered in the Arrivals Terminal of Mohammed V International Airport in Nouaceur Province, Greater Casablanca. It was established as a joint venture between Moroccan investors and Air Arabia.

attijariwafa-bank.name: Attijariwafa Bank
attijariwafa-bank.description: Attijariwafa Bank is a Moroccan international financial services group headquartered in Casablanca. It was formed by merging Banque Commerciale du Maroc and Wafabank, becoming one of the largest financial institutions in Morocco.

africa-independent-television.name: Africa Independent Television
africa-independent-television.description: Africa Independent Television (AIT) is a privately owned Nigerian television broadcaster headquartered in Abuja. It operates the largest privately operated terrestrial TV network in Nigeria and is a subsidiary of DAAR Communications plc.

aiteo.name: Aiteo
aiteo.description: Aiteo is Africa's largest privately owned integrated energy company involved in oil and gas exploration, production, refining, and marketing. It operates across West and Southern Africa.

afribank.name: Afribank
afribank.description: Afribank PLC was a commercial bank, real estate, and insurance broker based in Lagos, Nigeria, established in 1959 by French investors. It operated over 250 branches and was among the region's major banks.

african-food-network.name: African Food Network
african-food-network.description: African Food Network, or Afri Food Network, is a Nigerian website and company dedicated to African food and lifestyle. It was launched in January 2017 by Kevin Eze in Abuja, Nigeria.

afrinvest.name: Afrinvest
afrinvest.description: Afrinvest Limited is a Nigerian capital market holding company. It operates within the financial services industry in Nigeria. The company is notable for its role in the Nigerian capital market.

aero-contractors.name: Aero Contractors
aero-contractors.description: Aero Contractors Company of Nigeria Limited is a state-controlled Nigerian airline based at Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Ikeja, Lagos State. It operates helicopter services, fixed wing domestic and international scheduled passenger services, air charter, and third party aircraft operations, mainly supporting Nigeria's oil and gas industry.

arik-air.name: Arik Air
arik-air.description: Arik Air is a Nigerian airline operating mainly from hubs at Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Lagos and Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja. Its head office is located at the Arik Air Aviation Center on the grounds of Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Ikeja. It serves regional and mid-haul destinations within Africa.

allied-air.name: Allied Air
allied-air.description: Allied Air is a cargo airline based in Lagos, Nigeria. It operates scheduled and charter services within Nigeria and throughout Africa. Its main base is Murtala Mohammed International Airport, Lagos.

air-peace.name: Air Peace
air-peace.description: Air Peace Limited is a privately owned Nigerian airline founded in 2014 with its head office in Ikeja, Lagos State. It is the largest airline in West Africa, providing passenger and charter services to major Nigerian cities and international destinations including West Africa, the Middle East, the Caribbean, and the UK. It also has a subsidiary called Air Peace Hopper.

azman-air.name: Azman Air
azman-air.description: Azman Air Services Limited is a Nigerian domestic airline established in 2010 by Abdulmunaf Yunusa Sarina. It operates scheduled domestic passenger services with its main base at Mallam Aminu Kano International Airport in Kano.

africa-s-connection-stp.name: Africa's Connection STP
africa-s-connection-stp.hq: São Tomé, São Tomé and Príncipe
africa-s-connection-stp.description: Africa's Connection STP is an airline based in São Tomé. In 2014, it operated scheduled and charter services to Central and West Africa using 3 Dornier 228 aircraft. The airline is based in São Tomé and Príncipe.

awa-la-revue-de-la-femme-noire.name: AWA : la revue de la femme noire
awa-la-revue-de-la-femme-noire.legal_name: AWA : la revue de la femme noire
awa-la-revue-de-la-femme-noire.description: AWA : la revue de la femme noire was a Senegalese women's magazine published monthly from 1964 to 1973. It focused on topics relevant to black women in Senegal. The magazine is no longer in publication.

air-senegal.name: Air Senegal
air-senegal.description: Air Senegal is the flag carrier of the Republic of Senegal, created in 2016. It is state owned through the investment arm Caisse des Dépots et Consignation du Sénégal. The airline is based at Blaise Diagne International Airport in Dakar.

arlaadi-media-network.name: Arlaadi Media Network
arlaadi-media-network.description: Arlaadi Media Network (AMN) is an independent media organization based in Somalia, launched in 2021. It is the first network in Somalia to broadcast in the Maay dialect and operates an FM radio station, a television channel, and a research arm called the Arlaadi Institute for Policy Studies.

air-somalia.name: Air Somalia
air-somalia.description: Air Somalia was a privately owned airline based in Somalia and was the first private airline owned entirely by Somali nationals.

air-west.name: Air West
air-west.description: Air West is an airline based in Khartoum, Sudan, operating domestic passenger services and international cargo charters. Its main base is Khartoum International Airport, with a hub at Sharjah International Airport.

african-airlines-association.name: African Airlines Association
african-airlines-association.description: The African Airlines Association (AFRAA) is a trade association of African airlines founded in Accra, Ghana, in 1968. As of 2021, it is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, and aims to establish and facilitate cooperation between African airlines.

astral-aviation.name: Astral Aviation
astral-aviation.description: Astral Aviation is a cargo airline based in Nairobi, Kenya, established in 2000 and operating since 2001. It offers scheduled and ad-hoc cargo charters and humanitarian flights across Africa, Asia, and to Belgium, with a subsidiary in India operating since 2022.

als-aircraft-leasing-services.name: ALS – Aircraft Leasing Services
als-aircraft-leasing-services.description: ALS – Aircraft Leasing Services is a regional airline based in Nairobi, Kenya. It operates within the airline industry serving regional routes.

african-commission-on-human-and-peoples-.name: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights
african-commission-on-human-and-peoples-.legal_name: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights
african-commission-on-human-and-peoples-.description: The African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights is a quasi-judicial body that promotes and protects human rights across Africa. It interprets the African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights and investigates violations, although it lacks enforcement power.

accra-brewery-limited.name: Accra Brewery Limited
accra-brewery-limited.description: Accra Brewery Limited is a brewery located in Accra, Ghana. It operates in the beverage industry producing beer and related products. The company is based in Ghana's capital city.

access-bank-ghana-limited.name: Access Bank Ghana Limited
access-bank-ghana-limited.description: Access Bank Ghana Plc is a full-service commercial bank licensed by the Bank of Ghana. It provides a range of banking services within Ghana. The bank operates under the regulation of the national banking authority.

agricultural-development-bank-of-ghana.name: Agricultural Development Bank of Ghana
agricultural-development-bank-of-ghana.description: Agricultural Development Bank of Ghana (ADB) is a government-owned development and commercial bank. It is the first development finance institution established by the Ghanaian government, providing financial and technical services to agribusiness and rural enterprises. The bank is licensed by the Bank of Ghana.

animaxfyb-studio.name: AnimaxFYB Studio
animaxfyb-studio.description: AnimaxFYB Studios is an animation multimedia company based in Ghana, founded by Francis Yushua Brown. The studio specializes in 2D and 3D animation and visual effects, telling African stories through animation. It is the first African studio to have a project selected by Amazon Prime.

asoriba.name: Asoriba
asoriba.description: Asoriba is a technology company headquartered in Accra, Ghana. It provides a web application for church management and a mobile app that connects churches and worshipers, including donation functionality. The company also has a presence in Nigeria, Kenya, and South Africa.

aerogem-aviation.name: Aerogem Aviation
aerogem-aviation.description: Aerogem Aviation Ltd was a Ghanaian cargo airline based in Accra, Ghana. It operated worldwide non-scheduled cargo flights with main bases at Accra International Airport and Sharjah International Airport in the UAE. Its head office was located in the Gemini Airlines Building at Accra International Airport.

adzuna.name: Adzuna
adzuna.description: Adzuna is a search engine specializing in job advertisements. The summary does not specify its headquarters or additional details.

aeroalcool.name: Aeroalcool
aeroalcool.description: Aeroálcool is a Brazilian aerospace company based in Franca, São Paulo. It operates in the aerospace industry within Brazil.

andrade-gutierrez.name: Andrade Gutierrez
andrade-gutierrez.description: Andrade Gutierrez is a private multinational conglomerate headquartered in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. Founded in 1948 by the Andrade and Gutierrez families, it is the second largest construction company in Brazil with over a thousand projects completed domestically and internationally. The company has branches in 44 countries.

agencia-estado.name: Agência Estado
agencia-estado.description: Agência Estado is a private news agency in Brazil started by the Brazilian media group Grupo Estado. It operates within the Brazilian media landscape providing news services.

avibras.name: Avibras
avibras.description: Avibras Aeroco is a Brazilian aerospace and defense company producing artillery, aircraft defense systems, rockets, missiles, and armored vehicles. It also manufactures civilian transportation and telecommunications equipment. The company is based in Brazil.

aeromot.name: Aeromot
aeromot.description: Aeromot Aeronaves e Motores S.A is a Brazilian industrial group marketing aeronautical products. It was responsible for the aeronautical system of the 2014 World Cup and 2016 Summer Olympics. The company is based at Salgado Filho Airport in Porto Alegre, Brazil.

amadeo-rossi-s-a.name: Amadeo Rossi S.A.
amadeo-rossi-s-a.description: Amadeo Rossi S.A. is a Brazilian firearms manufacturer founded in 1889 in São Leopoldo. It produces pistols and revolvers for civilians and security forces and exports worldwide, being one of Brazil's largest weapons manufacturers.

advanced-composites-solutions.name: Advanced Composites Solutions
advanced-composites-solutions.description: Advanced Composites Solutions (ACS) is a Brazilian engineering company specializing in composite materials technology. It focuses mainly on the development and construction of light aircraft. The company operates in the aerospace industry.

aperam-south-america.name: Aperam South America
aperam-south-america.description: Aperam South America is the largest Brazilian manufacturer of specialty steels, headquartered in Belo Horizonte. It supplies stainless, silicon, and special carbon steels and is the only stainless steel maker in Latin America. The company also mines iron ore.

agencia-brasil.name: Agência Brasil
agencia-brasil.description: Agência Brasil is a nationwide public news agency in Brazil, operated by the Brazilian government. Founded in 1990, it is part of the public media corporation Empresa Brasil de Comunicação, which was created in 2007 to unite two government media enterprises. The agency publishes content under the CC-BY license.

algar-telecom.name: Algar Telecom
algar-telecom.description: Algar Telecom is a Brazilian telecommunications company operating in multiple states including Goiás, Minas Gerais, and São Paulo. It is the only operator that remained private after the creation of Telebrás and is the fifth largest in the telecommunications segment in Brazil.

alcantara-cyclone-space.name: Alcântara Cyclone Space
alcantara-cyclone-space.description: Alcântara Cyclone Space was a joint venture between Brazil and Ukraine established in 2006 to commercialize and launch satellites using the Ukrainian Cyclone-4 rocket from Brazil's Alcântara Launch Center. The cooperation was canceled by the Brazilian government in 2015.

aerosul-linhas-aereas.name: Aerosul Linhas Aéreas
aerosul-linhas-aereas.description: Aerosul Linhas Aéreas is a Brazilian airline based in Arapongas. It operates within the airline industry in Brazil.

asta-linhas-aereas.name: ASTA Linhas Aéreas
asta-linhas-aereas.description: ASTA Linhas Aéreas is a domestic airline based in Cuiabá, Brazil. Founded in 2009, it operates regular charter flights within the country.

aerogaviota.name: Aerogaviota
aerogaviota.description: Aerogaviota is a Cuban regional airline based in Havana. It operates domestic flights within Cuba and formerly served Jamaica. Its main base is Playa Baracoa Airport.

afrigen-biologics-and-vaccines.name: Afrigen Biologics and Vaccines
afrigen-biologics-and-vaccines.description: Afrigen Biologics and Vaccines is a South African biotechnology company based in Cape Town. The company operates within the biotech sector, focusing on biological and vaccine development. It is headquartered in Cape Town, South Africa.

africa-check.name: Africa Check
africa-check.description: Africa Check is a non-profit fact checking organisation established in 2012 to promote accuracy in public debate and media across Africa. It operates independently with offices in Johannesburg, Nairobi, Lagos, Dakar, and London, producing reports in English and French. The organisation tests claims made by public figures and institutions against available evidence.

atlantis-diesel-engines.name: Atlantis Diesel Engines
atlantis-diesel-engines.description: Atlantis Diesel Engines (ADE) is a South African manufacturer of diesel engines and components. It serves industries such as mining, on and off road applications, and defense forces. The company operates from Germiston, Gauteng, South Africa.

armscor.name: Armscor
armscor.description: Armscor is the arms procurement agency of the South African Department of Defence. Established in 1968, it was originally an arms production company created in response to UN sanctions against South Africa. It operates within the arms industry.

aspen-pharmacare.name: Aspen Pharmacare
aspen-pharmacare.description: Aspen Pharmacare Holdings Limited is a multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in uMhlanga, South Africa. Founded in 1997, it is the largest pharmaceutical company in Africa, manufacturing branded pharmaceuticals and generic HIV/AIDS and cancer medications.

airlink.name: Airlink
airlink.description: Airlink is a regional airline based in Johannesburg, South Africa. It initially provided services between smaller towns and larger hub airports and has expanded to include larger mainline routes.

allegiance-air.name: Allegiance Air
allegiance-air.description: Allegiance Air is a charter airline based in Lanseria, South Africa. It provides charter flight services from its base. The company operates within the South African aviation sector.

aerosud.name: Aerosud
aerosud.description: Aerosud is a South African aerospace engineering and manufacturing group headquartered in Centurion, Gauteng. It operates through Aerosud Holdings, Aerosud Aviation, and Aerosud Technology Solutions. The company is involved in the aerospace industry.

al24news.name: AL24news
al24news.description: AL24 News is an Algerian public international news channel broadcasting in Arabic, French, and English. It began operations on 1 November 2021, providing multilingual news coverage.

asmidal.name: Asmidal
asmidal.description: Asmidal is an Algerian industrial group that manages a portfolio of companies involved in the development, production, and marketing of fertilizers and pesticides. It is a leader in its field within Algeria.

algerian-tractors-company.name: Algerian Tractors Company
algerian-tractors-company.description: Algerian Tractors Company (ATC Spa) is an Algerian agricultural machinery manufacturer. It was created on August 16, 2012, as a joint venture between Etrag and the American group AGCO. The company produces tractors in El Khroub, near Constantine, Algeria.

algerie-ferries.name: Algérie Ferries
algerie-ferries.description: Algérie Ferries, also known as Entreprise Nationale de Transport Maritime de Voyageurs (ENTMV), is a state-owned Algerian shipping company. It operates passenger and freight services between Algeria, France, and Spain.

algerian-petroleum-institute.name: Algerian Petroleum Institute
algerian-petroleum-institute.description: The Algerian Petroleum Institute (IAP) is a national graduate institute of petroleum engineering located in Boumerdès, Algeria. Established in 1965 in collaboration with the French Institute of Petroleum, it provides graduate engineers and technicians to Sonatrach, Algeria's national oil company.

algerie-telecom.name: Algerie Telecom
algerie-telecom.description: Algeria Telecommunications Corporation is a state-owned company and the main telecommunications provider in Algeria. It is the sole operator of the fixed telephony network and broadband internet in the country.

atm-mobilis.name: ATM Mobilis
atm-mobilis.description: ATM Mobilis, a subsidiary of Groupe Télécom Algérie, is one of the three major mobile operators in Algeria. It became independent in August 2003 and operates in the mobile phone industry.

air-express-algeria.name: Air Express Algeria
air-express-algeria.description: Air Express Algeria is an Algerian charter airline primarily serving the oil and gas industries. It is based in Hassi Messaoud, Algeria. The airline focuses on providing specialized air transport services in this sector.

asmar.name: ASMAR
asmar.description: Astilleros y Maestranzas de la Armada (ASMAR) is a Chilean state-owned shipbuilding company providing services mainly to the Chilean Navy and other customers. It was restructured and adopted its current name in 1960, succeeding Arsenales de Marina created in 1895.

asenav.name: Asenav
asenav.description: Asenav is a Chilean shipbuilding company based in Santiago with main shipyards in Valdivia near the Pacific coast. It was established in 1974 by German immigrant Eberhard Kossmann. The company specializes in ship construction.

aerocardal.name: Aerocardal
aerocardal.description: Aerocardal is an airline based in Santiago, Chile. It operates international and domestic passenger charter services as well as medical services. Its main base is Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago.

aerovias-dap.name: Aerovías DAP
aerovias-dap.description: Aerovías DAP is a Chilean airline operating charter and scheduled flights, based in Punta Arenas, Chile. It is part of the DAP group, a consortium including several aviation-related companies such as AeroRescate and Antarctic Airways.

america-tv.name: América TV
america-tv.description: América TV is an Argentine television station broadcasting on channel 2 in La Plata, Buenos Aires Province. It is one of Argentina's five national television networks and is owned by Grupo América as its flagship television property.

arte-radiotelevisivo-argentino.name: Arte Radiotelevisivo Argentino
arte-radiotelevisivo-argentino.description: Arte Radiotelevisivo Argentino S.A., known as Artear, is an Argentine mass media company owned by the Clarín Group. It operates television stations and pay TV networks, produces content, and distributes it through digital platforms. Its flagship station is El Trece, based in Buenos Aires.

alot-store.name: Alot (store)
alot-store.description: Alot, formerly Staples Argentina, is the Argentine and Brazilian subsidiary of the American office supply chain Staples. Headquartered in Buenos Aires, it is the largest office supply company in Argentina and among the top three in Brazil.

acindar.name: Acindar
acindar.description: Acindar is an Argentine company operating in steel, agribusiness, industrial, and construction sectors. Founded in 1942, it has headquarters in Villa Constitución and production plants in several Argentine cities.

aerodreams.name: AeroDreams
aerodreams.description: AeroDreams S.A. is a defense contractor based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Since 2001, it has developed unmanned aerial vehicles for military and non-military use. The company's CEO is Raúl Fernández.

aerolineas-argentinas.name: Aerolíneas Argentinas
aerolineas-argentinas.description: Aerolíneas Argentinas is the state-owned flag carrier and largest airline of Argentina. Founded in 1949 from the merger of several airlines, it is headquartered in Buenos Aires. The airline joined the SkyTeam alliance in 2012 and its cargo division joined SkyTeam Cargo in 2013.

andes-lineas-aereas.name: Andes Líneas Aéreas
andes-lineas-aereas.description: Andes Líneas Aéreas is an Argentine airline based in Salta. It operates regional and charter flights to tourist destinations in Argentina and Brazil. Its main hub is Martín Miguel de Güemes International Airport in Salta.

aerochaco.name: Aerochaco
aerochaco.description: Aerochaco was an Argentine regional airline established in 1957 as a mixed-economy enterprise by the Chaco provincial government and Chaco Aero Club. It began operations in 1959 to improve connectivity between Chaco and northern provinces using de Havilland DHC-2 Beaver aircraft.

avianca-argentina.name: Avianca Argentina
avianca-argentina.description: Avianca Argentina, legally Avian Líneas Aéreas S.A., was an Argentine airline headquartered in Buenos Aires with its hub at Aeroparque Jorge Newbery. It operated under the Avianca brand but was independent of Avianca Holdings. The airline ceased operations in June 2019.

agrinar.name: Agrinar
agrinar.description: Agrinar SA is an Argentine agricultural machinery manufacturing company based in Granadero Baigorria, Santa Fe Province. It focuses on agricultural vehicles, producing mainly tractors, combine harvesters, and backhoe loaders. The company serves the agricultural sector in Argentina.

anglo-south-american-bank.name: Anglo-South American Bank
anglo-south-american-bank.industry: Financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
anglo-south-american-bank.description: The Anglo-South American Bank was a British and Argentine bank established in 1900 with the acquisition of the Anglo-Argentine Bank by the Bank of Tarapacá and London. It was initially named Bank of Tarapacá and Argentina and renamed Anglo-South American Bank in 1907.

argentine-rural-society.name: Argentine Rural Society
argentine-rural-society.description: The Sociedad Rural Argentina (SRA) is a landowners' association founded in 1866. It represents large agricultural producers in Argentina's Pampas region, focusing primarily on crop farming and livestock production.

argentine-red-cross.name: Argentine Red Cross
argentine-red-cross.description: The Argentine Red Cross is a humanitarian organization founded in 1880. It is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina. The organization is involved in emergency and relief efforts.

agroindustrial-pomalca.name: Agroindustrial Pomalca
agroindustrial-pomalca.description: Empresa Agroindustrial Pomalca is a leading agribusiness company based in Chiclayo, Peru. It is a major sugar producer with over 15,000 hectares of sugar cane and exports refined sugar to the United States. The company produces sugar, molasses, bagasse, and other agricultural exports.

aenza.name: Aenza
aenza.description: Aenza is a Latin American company originally founded in 1933 as a real estate and construction firm, now the oldest and largest in Peru. It operates in construction, energy, mining, sanitation, and highway services. The company changed its name from Graña y Montero to Aenza in 2020 following corruption scandals.

arca-continental-lindley.name: Arca Continental Lindley
arca-continental-lindley.description: Arca Continental Lindley S.A. is a Peruvian company that manufactures, distributes, and markets nonalcoholic beverages. It is the official bottler and distributor of Coca-Cola products in Peru and was formed in 2015 by merging Mexico-based Arca Continental and Peru-based Lindley S.A. The company is known for creating and marketing Inca Kola.

aero-condor.name: Aero Cóndor
aero-condor.description: Aero Cóndor S.A., also known as Aero Cóndor Peru, was an airline based in Lima, Peru. Founded in 1975, it provided domestic charter flights, cargo, scenic, and air ambulance services with its main hub at Jorge Chávez International Airport.

avianca-peru.name: Avianca Peru
avianca-peru.description: Avianca Perú S.A. was a Lima-based airline operating domestic and international services from Jorge Chávez International Airport. Part of the Synergy Group and Avianca Holdings, it operated flights under TACA Airlines' codes before ceasing operations in May 2020.

air-peru.name: Air Perú
air-peru.description: Air Perú International S.A.C. was a proposed airline based in Lima, Peru. It planned to operate scheduled domestic and international flights to Asia, Europe, South America, and the United States. Its main base was intended to be Jorge Chávez International Airport.

aviandina.name: Aviandina
aviandina.description: Aviandina was a small Peruvian airline operational from 1999 to 2003. It was a subsidiary of Aero Continente. The airline is no longer active.

avior-airlines.name: Avior Airlines
avior-airlines.description: Avior Airlines C.A. is an airline based in Barcelona, Venezuela. It operates scheduled and charter services within Venezuela and the southern Caribbean from its main hub at Generál José Antonio Anzoátegui International Airport. It is the largest private capital airline in Venezuela by fleet, destinations, and employees.

aeropostal-alas-de-venezuela.name: Aeropostal Alas de Venezuela
aeropostal-alas-de-venezuela.description: Aeropostal Alas de Venezuela C.A. is a state-owned airline based in Caracas, Venezuela. It operates domestic and Caribbean international services from its main base at Simón Bolívar International Airport. The airline ceased operations in 2017 but announced resumption of scheduled service in 2018.

aero-ejecutivos.name: Aero Ejecutivos
aero-ejecutivos.description: AeroEjecutivos C.A. was a Venezuelan scheduled and charter regional airline headquartered in Maiquetia. It was based at Óscar Machado Zuloaga International Airport and operated regional flights.

avior-regional.name: Avior Regional
avior-regional.description: Avior Regional was a Venezuelan regional airline and a subsidiary of Avior Airlines. It began operations in March 2015 with flights from Caracas to Barinas, Valera, and Curaçao.

albatros-airlines.name: Albatros Airlines
albatros-airlines.description: Albatros Airlines is a Venezuelan charter airline with private capital. It is authorized to carry out flights for the transfer of passengers and cargo within Venezuela.

alcasa.name: Alcasa
alcasa.description: C.V.G. Aluminio del Caroní S.A., known as Alcasa, is a state-owned aluminium producer in Venezuela. Founded in 1960 and operational since 1967, it is part of the Corporación Venezolana de Guayana and one of the world's largest aluminium producers.

avianca-ecuador.name: Avianca Ecuador
avianca-ecuador.description: Avianca Ecuador S.A. is an airline based in Quito, Ecuador. It operates passenger and cargo flights within Ecuador, including routes to the Galápagos Islands, and international flights to Colombia. It is part of the Avianca Group of Latin American airlines.

av-villas-bank.name: AV Villas Bank
av-villas-bank.description: Banco AV Villas is a medium-range Colombian bank and one of the four banks forming Grupo Aval. It operates in the financial sector in Colombia.

auteco.name: Auteco
auteco.description: Auteco is a Colombian manufacturer of motor vehicles and was the first motorcycle assembler in the country.

alpina-productos-alimenticios.name: Alpina Productos Alimenticios
alpina-productos-alimenticios.description: Alpina Productos Alimenticios is a Colombian dairy, food, and beverage company founded in 1945 and based in Bogotá. It operates in Colombia and the United States, producing a variety of dairy and food products.

avianca.name: Avianca
avianca.description: Avianca S.A. is the largest airline in Colombia and the second largest in South America. Headquartered in Bogotá with its registered office in Barranquilla, it operates a vast network of destinations in the Americas. Avianca has been the flag carrier of Colombia since 1919 and uses a codesharing system among its group of airlines.

aeroasis.name: Aeroasis
aeroasis.description: AerOasis was a startup airline based at El Dorado International Airport in Colombia. It operated in the airline industry with a focus on passenger air transport. The company was headquartered at one of Colombia's main international airports.

aercaribe.name: AerCaribe
aercaribe.description: AerCaribe S.A. is a Colombia-based carrier operating domestic and Americas-wide executive, charter, and cargo services, including specialized fuel and military transport. It is based at El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá with a secondary base in Lima. The company operates a fleet of turboprop and jet aircraft.

aerocon.name: Aerocon
aerocon.hq: Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia
aerocon.description: Aero Comercial Oriente Norte Ltda., operating as Aerocon, was a Bolivian airline with its national office located in Hangar 93 at El Trompillo Airport in Santa Cruz de la Sierra.

ancap.name: ANCAP
ancap.description: ANCAP is a state-owned company in Uruguay created in 1931. It holds the monopoly on national alcohol, fuel, and portland cement, and operates the only oil refinery in Uruguay located in La Teja. ANCAP imports, refines, and sells petroleum derivatives.

air-class.name: Air Class
air-class.description: Air Class Líneas Aéreas is a cargo airline based in Montevideo, Uruguay. It operates freight and scheduled or charter passenger services, with its main base at Carrasco International Airport.

aeromas.name: Aeromás
aeromas.description: Aeromás is a cargo and private jet charter airline based at Carrasco International Airport in Montevideo, Uruguay. It operates in the commercial air transport market primarily in Uruguay and Mercosur. The company began commercial aviation activities in 1983 with banner towing and expanded to passenger and cargo air transport in 1988.

amaszonas-uruguay.name: Amaszonas Uruguay
amaszonas-uruguay.description: Amaszonas Uruguay was the flag carrier airline of Uruguay, operating commercial passenger services from hubs at Carrasco International Airport and Laguna del Sauce International Airport. It served major South American destinations and several secondary locations in the Southern Cone.

avianca-guatemala.name: Avianca Guatemala
avianca-guatemala.description: Aviateca S.A., branded Avianca Guatemala, is a regional airline headquartered in Guatemala City and serves as the flag carrier of Guatemala. It was government-owned until 1989, then privatized and joined the Grupo TACA alliance, later merging with Avianca.

arm-aviacion.name: ARM Aviación
arm-aviacion.description: ARM Aviación is a private charter airline based in Zone 13, Guatemala City, Guatemala. Its main hub is La Aurora International Airport.

aviatsa.name: Aviatsa
aviatsa.description: Aviatsa S.A. de C.V. is a Honduran charter airline established in 2015 after receiving certification from Honduran Aviation Authorities. In early 2024, it announced plans to open a commercial route between Havana, Cuba and San Pedro Sula, Honduras. The airline is based in Honduras.

aerolineas-sosa.name: Aerolíneas Sosa
aerolineas-sosa.description: Aerolíneas Sosa S.A. de C.V. is an airline based in La Ceiba, Honduras, established in 1976. It operates domestic scheduled flights to four destinations and offers charter services, with its main hub at Golosón International Airport.

avianca-honduras.name: Avianca Honduras
avianca-honduras.description: Avianca Honduras, branded by Isleña de Inversiones S.A. de C.V., is a regional airline based in San Pedro Sula, Honduras. It operates scheduled and charter passenger flights from Ramón Villeda Morales International Airport and is part of the Avianca Group.

altice-dominicana.name: Altice Dominicana
altice-dominicana.description: Altice Dominicana, operating as Altice, is the second largest landline service provider in the Dominican Republic. It offers HDTV cable TV, landline, wireless voice services, and high-speed internet as part of the French Netherlands-based Altice group.

aeronaves-dominicanas.name: Aeronaves Dominicanas
aeronaves-dominicanas.description: Volo Airways Dominicana is a charter airline with facilities at Las Americas International Airport and offices in Santo Domingo. Founded in 1980, it is the longest-lived airline in the Dominican Republic and underwent ownership changes in 2023/2024.

air-century.name: Air Century
air-century.hq: La Isabela International Airport, Dominican Republic
air-century.description: ACSA - Air Century, S.A. is a Dominican airline operating charter and scheduled services from La Isabela International Airport. Founded by Captain Omar Chahin, it began operations in 1992 and is the longest-running active Dominican airline.

arajet.name: Arajet
arajet.description: Arajet, S.A., trading as Arajet, is the flag carrier and largest airline of the Dominican Republic headquartered in Santo Domingo. It offers low-cost flights across North America, the Caribbean, Central America, and South America, starting operations in September 2022.

african-export-import-bank.name: African Export-Import Bank
african-export-import-bank.description: African Export–Import Bank, also known as Afreximbank, is a pan-African supranational multilateral financial institution created in 1993 under the African Development Bank. It is headquartered in Cairo, Egypt, and was officially launched at its first general meeting in Abuja, Nigeria.

arab-african-international-bank.name: Arab African International Bank
arab-african-international-bank.description: Arab African International Bank (AAIB) is a major Egyptian bank and one of the big five banks in Egypt. It operates not only in Egypt but also has branches in the United Arab Emirates and Lebanon.

al-arabia-cinema-production-distribution.name: Al Arabia Cinema Production & Distribution
al-arabia-cinema-production-distribution.description: Al Arabia Cinema Production & Distribution is an Egyptian film distribution and production company based in Cairo with an office in Dubai. Founded in 2000, it operates Renaissance Cinemas with 21 cinemas in Egypt and is part of the Mediterranean Distribution Network. The company has produced and distributed over 100 movies.

abu-zaabal-engineering-industries.name: Abu Zaabal Engineering Industries
abu-zaabal-engineering-industries.description: The Abu Zaabal Engineering Industries Company, also known as Military Factory 100, is an Egyptian government joint-stock company affiliated with the Ministry of Military Production. Established in 1974 and reopened in 1983, it is located in Abu Zaabal, Qalyubia Governorate, and produces artillery for the Egyptian Armed Forces.

abu-zaabal-specialized-industries.name: Abu Zaabal Specialized Industries
abu-zaabal-specialized-industries.description: The Abu Zaabal Specialized Industries Company, or Military Factory 300, is an Egyptian government joint-stock company affiliated with the Ministry of Military Production. Established in 2016 and located in Abu Zaabal, Qalyubia Governorate, it produces small and medium weapons and various types of ammunition.

arab-british-helicopter-company.name: Arab British Helicopter Company
arab-british-helicopter-company.description: The Arab British Helicopter Company (ABHCO) is an Anglo-Italiano-Egyptian joint venture specializing in helicopter manufacturing. It operates in the aerospace industry.

arab-contractors.name: Arab Contractors
arab-contractors.description: The Arab Contractors, known locally as Al Mokawloon Al Arab, is a regional construction and contracting company based in Egypt.

amc-airlines.name: AMC Airlines
amc-airlines.description: AMC Airlines is a charter airline based in Cairo, Egypt. It operates charter flights from Egypt's tourist destinations to Europe, the Middle East, and domestic locations. The airline also provides VIP and military transport services, with its main base at Cairo International Airport.

air-arabia-egypt.name: Air Arabia Egypt
air-arabia-egypt.description: Air Arabia Egypt is an Egyptian low-cost airline based in Alexandria and a subsidiary of Air Arabia. Its head office is located in Heliopolis, Cairo, Egypt. The airline focuses on providing affordable air travel options within the region.

almasria-universal-airlines.name: AlMasria Universal Airlines
almasria-universal-airlines.description: AlMasria Universal Airlines is a private Egyptian airline operating scheduled and charter services from Egypt. The name 'AlMasria' is derived from the Arabic word for 'Egyptian'.

air-cairo.name: Air Cairo
air-cairo.description: Air Cairo is an airline based in Cairo, Egypt, part owned by EgyptAir. It operates scheduled flights to the Middle East and Europe and charter flights to Egypt from Europe. Its bases include Cairo International Airport, Sharm El Sheikh International Airport, and Hurghada International Airport.

alexandria-airlines.name: Alexandria Airlines
alexandria-airlines.description: Alexandria Airlines is an Egyptian airline headquartered in Cairo. It provides air transport services within the region.

air-sinai.name: Air Sinai
air-sinai.description: Air Sinai was an airline based in Cairo, Egypt. It operated as a 'paper airline' for its parent company Egyptair, serving flights exclusively between Egypt and Israel under a wet lease-like agreement.

air-leisure.name: Air Leisure
air-leisure.description: Air Leisure was an Egyptian charter airline headquartered in Cairo and based at Cairo International Airport. It connected several Asian cities, mainly in China, with Egyptian leisure destinations.

agricultural-bank-of-egypt.name: Agricultural Bank Of Egypt
agricultural-bank-of-egypt.description: Agricultural Bank of Egypt (ABE) is a medium-sized public bank in Egypt. It specializes in agricultural banking within the country.

avianca-costa-rica.name: Avianca Costa Rica
avianca-costa-rica.description: Avianca Costa Rica S.A., using the callsign LACSA, is the national airline of Costa Rica based in San José. It operates international scheduled services to over 35 destinations in the Americas and became part of the Avianca Group after the purchase of Grupo TACA in 2013.

aeroperlas.name: Aeroperlas
aeroperlas.description: Aeroperlas was a regional airline based in Panama City, Panama. It was the third largest airline in the country and operated over 50 daily scheduled flights to 15 domestic destinations from its hubs. Aeroperlas was part of the Grupo TACA regional airlines system.

air-panama.name: Air Panamá
air-panama.hq: Albrook "Marcos A. Gelabert" International Airport, Panama
air-panama.description: Air Panama is a regional airline based at Albrook "Marcos A. Gelabert" International Airport in Panama. It is the second-largest air carrier in the country and offers scheduled and charter passenger flights to more than 31 destinations from its hub.

air-nicaragua.name: Air Nicaragua
air-nicaragua.description: Air Nicaragua was a proposed airline intended to be the national flag carrier of Nicaragua. Its main base was planned to be Augusto C. Sandino International Airport. The airline was never established.

air-mali.name: Air Mali
air-mali.description: Air Mali was an airline based in Mali, formed in April 2005 by the Aga Khan Fund for Economic Development and the government of Mali. It operated in the aviation sector.

angola-telecom.name: Angola Telecom
angola-telecom.description: Angola Telecom is a telecommunications and Internet service provider wholly owned by the Angolan state. It operates as a public company serving Angola.

angola-red-cross.name: Angola Red Cross
angola-red-cross.description: The Angola Red Cross, founded in 1978, is a humanitarian organization with its headquarters in Luanda, Angola.

aeronautica.name: Aeronáutica
aeronautica.description: Aeronáutica was an airline based in Luanda, Angola, operating domestic chartered freight and passenger flights from Quatro de Fevereiro Airport.

angola-air-charter.name: Angola Air Charter
angola-air-charter.description: Angola Air Charter is a charter airline based in Luanda, Angola, operating cargo charters in Africa from Quatro de Fevereiro Airport. It is banned in EU airspace and other regions.

auric-air.name: Auric Air
auric-air.description: Auric Air Services Limited is a privately owned airline based in Tanzania. It operates scheduled flights to 42 destinations within East Africa and offers private non-scheduled air charters from multiple airports including Dar-es-salaam and Arusha.

as-salaam-air.name: As Salaam Air
as-salaam-air.description: As Salaam Air is an airline based in Zanzibar, Tanzania, offering private charters and scheduled flights within Tanzania. The airline operates two Embraer 120 aircraft.

air-centrafrique.name: Air Centrafrique
air-centrafrique.description: Air Centrafrique was the flag carrier airline of the Central African Republic from 1966 to the late 1970s. It operated domestic services and was headquartered in Bangui.

asky-airlines.name: Asky Airlines
asky-airlines.description: ASKY Airlines is a private multinational passenger airline headquartered in Lomé, Togo. It serves West and Central Africa with its hub at Lomé–Tokoin International Airport. The airline operates in the aviation sector.

arab-international-bank-of-tunisia.name: Arab International Bank of Tunisia
arab-international-bank-of-tunisia.description: Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie (BIAT) is the largest private sector bank in Tunisia. It is publicly listed on the Tunisian Stock Exchange and operates within the banking industry.

amen-bank.name: Amen Bank
amen-bank.description: Amen Bank is a private sector bank based in Tunisia. It operates in the financial services industry and is listed on the Bourse de Tunis. The bank is part of Tunisia's banking sector.

arab-tunisian-bank.name: Arab Tunisian Bank
arab-tunisian-bank.description: Arab Tunisian Bank (ATB) is a Tunisian commercial bank created on June 30, 1982, through the integration of a branch of Arab Bank Tunis with Tunisian individuals. Its mission focuses on contributing to the economic and financial development of Tunisia.

air-zimbabwe.name: Air Zimbabwe
air-zimbabwe.description: Air Zimbabwe (Pvt) Ltd is the flag carrier airline of Zimbabwe, headquartered at Robert Gabriel Mugabe International Airport in Harare. It operates domestic and regional flights, with a history of financial difficulties causing intermittent service suspensions and resumptions.

anima-estudios.name: Ánima Estudios
anima-estudios.description: Ánima Estudios is a Mexican animation studio founded in 2002 and based in Mexico City. Its first film, Magos y Gigantes, was released in November 2003.

axtel.name: Axtel
axtel.description: Axtel S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican telecommunications company headquartered in San Pedro, near Monterrey. It offers telephone, internet, and television services through FTTH in 45 cities and provides IT services. It is the second largest landline telephone service provider in Mexico.

aeropuertos-y-servicios-auxiliares.name: Aeropuertos y Servicios Auxiliares
aeropuertos-y-servicios-auxiliares.description: Aeropuertos y Servicios Auxiliares (ASA) is a Mexican Federal Government-owned company headquartered in Mexico City. Established in 1965, it manages, operates, and develops Mexico's airports, operating 10 airports and part-operating 4 others, while also providing aviation fuel at 63 locations.

altos-hornos-de-mexico.name: Altos Hornos de México
altos-hornos-de-mexico.description: Altos Hornos de México, S.A.B. de C.V. (AHMSA) is a steel plant located in Monclova, Coahuila, Mexico. It operates in the iron and steel industry and is situated approximately 155 miles from the United States border.

aeromexico.name: Aeroméxico
aeromexico.description: Aerovías de México, S.A. de C.V., operating as Aeroméxico, is the flag carrier airline of Mexico based in Mexico City. It operates scheduled flights to over 120 destinations across the Americas, the Caribbean, Europe, and Asia, with its main hub at Mexico City International Airport.

aeromexico-connect.name: Aeroméxico Connect
aeromexico-connect.description: Aeroméxico Connect, formerly Aerolitoral, is a regional airline subsidiary of Aeroméxico based in Monterrey, Mexico. It operates Embraer 190 aircraft and provides feeder services to Aeroméxico's hubs with over 300 daily flights to destinations in Mexico, the US, Central America, and the Caribbean.

avianca-cargo-mexico.name: Avianca Cargo México
avianca-cargo-mexico.description: Avianca Cargo México, formerly AeroUnion, is a scheduled cargo airline headquartered at Mexico City International Airport. It operates cargo services within Mexico and between Mexico and the United States.

aerodavinci.name: Aerodavinci
aerodavinci.description: Aerodavinci, officially Aero DaVinci Internacional, is an airline based in Reynosa, Tamaulipas, Mexico. Operating since 1997, it provides air taxi, cargo, and charter services.

avioquintana.name: Avioquintana
avioquintana.description: Avioquintana, or Aviones de Renta de Quintana Roo, is an air taxi service based in Quintana Roo, Mexico. Established in 1997, it operates domestic private charter services with its main base at Cancún International Airport and a hub at Chetumal International Airport.

aerolineas-ejecutivas.name: Aerolíneas Ejecutivas
aerolineas-ejecutivas.description: Aerolíneas Ejecutivas is an air charter operator founded in 1968 by Arturo Ortega Olive. As of 2015, it operated a fleet of 27 aircraft and flew approximately 15,000 hours per year.

aereo-servicio-guerrero.name: Aéreo Servicio Guerrero
aereo-servicio-guerrero.description: Aéreo Servicio Guerrero is a Mexican regional airline founded in 1997. It is based at Hermosillo International Airport. The airline operates regional flights within Mexico.

aeronaves-tsm.name: Aeronaves TSM
aeronaves-tsm.description: Aeronaves TSM is a Mexican cargo charter airline headquartered in Saltillo. It operates from Saltillo Airport and specializes in cargo charter services. The company focuses on air freight transportation.

air-botswana.name: Air Botswana
air-botswana.description: Air Botswana Corporation is the state-owned national flag carrier of Botswana, headquartered in Gaborone. It operates scheduled domestic and regional flights from Sir Seretse Khama International Airport.

air-burkina.name: Air Burkina
air-burkina.description: Air Burkina SA is the national airline of Burkina Faso, operating scheduled domestic and regional international flights from its main base at Ouagadougou Airport. The airline was majority owned by an AKFED/IPS consortium from 2001 to 2017 but is now back in government ownership. It serves destinations in several West African countries.

ab-aviation.name: AB Aviation
ab-aviation.description: AB Aviation was a private regional airline and the largest in the Comoros, headquartered at Prince Said Ibrahim International Airport. The airline's air operator's certificate was revoked following a fatal accident in February 2022.

africanews.name: Africanews
africanews.description: Africanews is a 24/7 pan-African multilingual news network based in Lyon, France, previously headquartered in Pointe-Noire, Republic of the Congo. It began broadcasting online and via TV and satellite on 20 April 2016.

air-kasai.name: Air Kasaï
air-kasai.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
air-kasai.description: Air Kasaï is an airline headquartered at N'Dolo Airport in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. It operates charter services within Africa with its main base at N'Dolo Airport.

air-tropiques.name: Air Tropiques
air-tropiques.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
air-tropiques.description: Air Tropiques was an airline based in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. It operated domestic, regional, and charter flights from its main base at N'Dolo Airport. The airline is no longer active.

air-djibouti.name: Air Djibouti
air-djibouti.description: Air Djibouti, also known as Red Sea Airlines, is the flag carrier of Djibouti. It first operated in 1963, ceased operations in 2002, and was relaunched in 2015 with cargo and passenger services. The airline is headquartered in Djibouti city.

air-annobon.name: Air Annobón
air-annobon.hq: San Antonio de Palé, Equatorial Guinea
air-annobon.description: Air Annobón was an Equatoguinean airline that began operations in January 2013 with flights between Malabo and Bata. It initially operated wet leased aircraft and later purchased its own plane. The airline suspended operations in September 2016 after failing to find a joint venture partner to resume flights as a low-cost carrier.

asmara-brewery.name: Asmara Brewery
asmara-brewery.description: Asmara Brewery is a brewery in Eritrea founded in 1938. It was nationalized during the Eritrean War of Independence and operates a football team competing in the Eritrean Premier League. The brewery employs over 600 people.
